BYZ.name: Form Rome
BYZ.desc: Lets BYZ, TRE form Rome.

BYZ.name: Akritai
BYZ.desc: Primarily focused on border defense, these light troops are also given lands to farm as well as protect. Akritai are most adept at defensive warfare, especially against cavalry, and are often the first response against external threats.

BYZ.name: Ancient Greek Studies
BYZ.desc: The rediscovery and revival of ancient Greek arts has provided us with a wonderful opportunity to better educate the masses and to preserve our lofty scientific and cultural ideals. We shall make a diligent study of the wisdom of our ancestors.

BYZ.name: Aqueduct System
BYZ.desc: Through carefully laid stone channels and gravity-fed conduits, this construct secures a steady supply of fresh water. While simple in construction, these works mark the first step toward organized urban water management.

BYZ.name: Autokratoría Rhōmaíōn
BYZ.desc: Our great nation is the undisputed heir to the splendor and prestige of Rome, and reclaiming that long-lost territory is our primary motivation.

BYZ.name: Byzantine Bureaucracy
BYZ.desc: Our administration heaves under the weight of our complex web of bureaucracies, a legacy of centuries of imperial rule.

BYZ.name: Byzantine Historiography
BYZ.desc: Our people stand on the shoulders of giants; it is our responsibility to leave comprehensive records of our empire's glory to inspire and instruct future generations. By thoroughly documenting the lives of our extraordinary ancestors, tracing our prestigious lineages, and detailing our intricate traditions, we will surpass mere historical records and become truly legendary.

BYZ.name: Byzantine Inquisition
BYZ.desc: Europe is engulfed in religious turmoil. We must be prepared to rip up noxious weeds of heresy that appear in the garden of our Empire, lest it become overgrown with heathens. Our pious defense against heretic incursion will prevent us from sinking into instability.

BYZ.name: Court of Languages
BYZ.desc: The court of Constantinople attracts diplomats and dignitaries from every corner of the known world. As a result, we ensure all languages receive equal respect and accommodation, a practical necessity for an empire at the crossroads of civilizations.

BYZ.name: Expand the Varangian Guard
BYZ.desc: The Varangians have served our country for centuries with distinguished honor and unwavering faith. By expanding their ranks, we will further secure the stability and protection of Byzantium.

BYZ.name: Expanded Aqueduct Systems
BYZ.desc: The growth of our urban centers has created an increasing demand for reliable fresh water. If our towns and cities are to flourish, we must commit to greater feats of engineering and expand our aqueduct networks.

BYZ.name: Heart of Orthodoxy
BYZ.desc: Constantinople is the beating heart of vibrant faith. We take great pride in being the home of Orthodoxy, holders of the Ecumenical Patriarchate, and defenders of Christendom against our heathen enemies.

BYZ.name: Imperial Varangian Guard
BYZ.desc: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.

BYZ.name: Imperial Varangians
BYZ.desc: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.

BYZ.name: Intercontinental Crossroads
BYZ.desc: Byzantium is located between Europe and Asia, making it in many ways the connection between East and West. Our advantageous position is highly lucrative, and has also allowed us to significantly expand our maritime influence.

BYZ.name: Late Cataphracts
BYZ.desc: Although warfare has evolved significantly since the first incarnation of our empire, including the introduction of gunpowder, the battle tactics refined by our forebears centuries ago are often still effective. Our cataphracts shall embody the best of both our ancient and modern combat wisdom.

BYZ.name: Men of Letters
BYZ.desc: It is no secret that other nations envy our literary accomplishments and enlightened past. They seek to hire tutors from our court, eager to sink their claws into the knowledge that gave rise to powerful empires and carved the cultural landscape of the entire continent. It is through these men of letters that our neighbors will come to fall in love with our history and become educated in our ways.

BYZ.name: Modernized Stratēgikon
BYZ.desc: The Strategikon (the ancient manual of cavalry tactics, logistics, and battlefield doctrine) has served us well in times of war. However, as war changes, so must we. Our tactics and regiments have adapted to modern combat, employing weapons of such destruction that Maurice himself could never have anticipated their devastation.

BYZ.name: Modernized Varangians
BYZ.desc: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.

BYZ.name: Pelekyphóroi Varangians
BYZ.desc: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.

BYZ.name: Poikilia
BYZ.desc: Byzantine culture has taken Europe by storm, particularly poikilia, our unique aesthetic. Emphasizing visual variety and a dizzying array of vibrant hues, poikilia creates a symphony of colors and elements in our art and architecture alike.

BYZ.name: Reformed Synod Proceedings
BYZ.desc: Bureaucracy is a nightmarish endeavor for a country our size. To better refine the religious proceedings required every time we call the Orthodox Synod, we will cut down on the red tape, and revisit the associated legislation.

BYZ.name: Restored Varangians
BYZ.desc: Powerful warriors that originally hailed from the northern Viking lands, these select few ferocious soldiers make up the core of the royal guard. Armed with axes and shields, they have often been described as pelekyphóroi bárbaroi, axe-wielding barbarians.

BYZ.name: Shield of the West
BYZ.desc: We stand between Europe and a sea of heathens, a shield against foreign threats. Our sword will forever be raised against those who seek to eradicate our faith, ready to strike against any who disrespect our traditions.

BYZ.name: The City-Taker
BYZ.desc: We are already familiar with deploying and refining powerful siege engines. However, by adapting our designs to use gunpowder, we will be able to completely dominate our foes with our cannons.

BYZ.name: The New Imperial Army
BYZ.desc: Our army has lagged behind others in Europe for far too long. By enacting sweeping military reform and expanding our conscription efforts, we hope to build a modern army befitting the resurgent and resplendent phoenix that symbolizes our empire.

BYZ.name: Allelengyon
BYZ.desc: Originally conceived under Emperor Basil II (commonly known by his nickname the Bulgar-Slayer) and deriving from the Greek word allilengýi (solidarity), the Allelengyon was a tax obligation designed to redistribute fiscal burden. When smallholders fail to meet their dues, responsibility is legally transferred to wealthier landowners of the district, ensuring imperial revenue while preventing the ruin and absorption of peasant lands. In this way, fiscal solidarity becomes a lever of stability and control.

BYZ.name: Books of the Basiliká
BYZ.desc: Building upon Justinian's Corpus Juris Civilis, the Books of the Basiliká reorganize Roman law into a coherent Greek legal corpus. By clarifying, standardizing, and harmonizing centuries of jurisprudence, they render the Emperor's law undisputed, authoritative, and universal.

BYZ.name: Court Eunuchs
BYZ.desc: Educated, loyal, and excluded from dynastic ambition, court eunuchs form a trusted administrative cadre. Their proximity to the Emperor and insulation from familial power make them ideal stewards of palace governance, finance, and imperial correspondence.

BYZ.name: Honorary Titles
BYZ.desc:
From the Patrikios and Anthypatos to the Magistros and Kouropalatēs, our court governs ambition through dignity rather than command.

This intricate system, revolving around the bestowing of ranked honors, silks, and privileges, allows the Emperor to bind generals, senators, and provincial elites to the throne by rewarding loyalty, defusing rivalry, and turning prestige itself into an instrument of rule.

BYZ.name: Imperial Breadbasket
BYZ.desc: This location has been entrusted with provisioning the wider realm, its granaries expanded to account for our ambitious plans. Grain flows inward and outward under imperial supervision, sustaining the citizens and army alike with abundance.

BYZ.name: Imperial Senate
BYZ.desc: Composed of senior dignitaries appointed by imperial authority, the Senate serves as a body of acclamation and counsel. Its assent legitimizes reigns, successions, and major acts, preserving Roman continuity while ensuring that sovereignty remains firmly imperial.

BYZ.name: Kephalai
BYZ.desc: The Kephalai are administrative and legal compendia designed to render imperial governance practicable. Replacing older regional arrangements such as the Katepaníkion, they distill law, taxation, and military obligations into standardized directives, ensuring uniform rule across the provinces.
mods: Monthly Prosperity in towns and cities

BYZ.name: Latinitas vs Rōmanismós
BYZ.desc: A country embracing Latinitas looks to the powers of the Latin West—Italian republics, Frankish courts, and the currents of the Renaissance—for support, partnership, and renewal through diplomacy and selective accommodation. One rooted in Rōmanismós holds fast to its unbroken Roman inheritance, upheld by the Orthodox faith, the institutions of the imperial administration, and the enduring tradition of Constantinople.

BYZ.name: Municipia Privileges
BYZ.desc: This location has been elevated to the status of municipium, its citizens granted rights under our law. Local elites wield greater influence, binding the land closer to the traditions of Latinization.
mods: Local Latin Revival Movement Growth Modifier

BYZ.name: Nómos Émpsychos
BYZ.desc: Deriving from the concept of living law (Nómos Émpsychos), the Emperor forms a fundamental cornerstone of our administration and embodies sovereign authority itself. First articulated under Justinian, this principle binds legislation, justice, and command to the imperial person, placing the ruler at the very core of the Roman state.

BYZ.name: Reforming the Army
BYZ.desc: Whilst our army dominated in the past using the Themata and the numerous levies they provided, the increase in wealth and the centralization of realms has led to armies becoming a full-time profession. with council has been hard at work drafting a new army organization, one that depends less on the Nobility for troops.

BYZ.name: Ritualistic Court
BYZ.desc: Ceremony is governance made visible. Through regulated ritual, precedence, and spectacle, the imperial court transforms authority into sacred theatre, ordering hierarchy at home while overwhelming foreign envoys with the majesty of our great capital, the perceived center of the civilized world.

BYZ.name: Romanitas
BYZ.desc: Romanitas affirms uninterrupted Roman statehood. The Emperor rules not by conquest or ethnicity, but as the lawful inheritor of authority, law, and tradition that dates back over a millennium. This identity binds empire and faith together, presenting Roman rule as divinely sanctioned and morally supreme.

BYZ.name: Silk Monopoly of Constantinople
BYZ.desc: Within Constantinople, the production of Silk is held to a high standard, a long tradition that spans generations. Workshops flourish under imperial oversight, though all production dances to the tune of monopoly.

BYZ.name: Strategarchia
BYZ.desc: The Strategarchia embodies the institutional command of the imperial army. Generals are appointed, rotated, and restrained by bureaucracy, ensuring that military power serves the state rather than personal ambition. Warfare is thus rendered an administrative function, governed by hierarchy rather than fealty, while ensuring only the best rise to the top.

BYZ.name: Thémata
BYZ.desc: Formed in response to existential pressure, the Thémata divide the empire into provincial military-administrative districts. Each of these divisions is governed by a Strategós who unites civil and military authority, enabling rapid local defense while remaining formally subordinate to the imperial hierarchy.

CAS.name: Casa de Contratación
CAS.desc: The Casa de Contratación is an agency that administers Spanish colonial operations. All voyages of exploration and trade must receive its approval, and it collects all colonial taxes. The Casa is also charged with safeguarding classified information about new trade routes and valuable discoveries.

CAS.name: Crown of Castile
CAS.desc: When the Kingdoms of Castile and León formed a definitive union in 1230, the Crown of Castile was born. Since then, the country has aimed to become the hegemonic power in Iberia, and one of the greatest and most prestigious nations in Europe.
mods: Clergy Estate Satisfaction Equilibrium (Has emerged victorious in the situation)
Trade Income (Has emerged victorious in the situation)

CAS.name: Iberian Tolerance
CAS.desc: Iberia is inhabited by a multitude of people with different faiths and beliefs. To force them to follow one or to expel those with different beliefs than the ruling class would be a grave mistake, and hurt our country more than it would do good. For us to achieve greatness, we must embrace this diversity.

CAS.name: Intendancy System
CAS.desc: The Intendancy System is a new system of governance aimed at centralizing the authority of the Crown over that of the bureaucrats in order to oversee tax collection and implement anti-corruption measures.

CAS.name: Nueva Planta
CAS.desc: The Nueva Planta is a series of decrees and reforms formalized in order to abolish regional legal privileges and forge a single, unitary state under central authority.

CAS.name: Royal Council of Castile
CAS.desc: The Royal Council of Castile is a centralized royal council to streamline taxation, justice, and administration under the direct oversight of the Crown.

CAS.name: Royal Factories
CAS.desc: Royal Factories are state-funded manufactories directly overseen by the Crown to produce strategic and luxury goods in support of mercantilist and centralized economic policies.

CAS.name: Santa Hermandad
CAS.desc: The Santa Hermandad is a permanent royal constabulary charged with policing the roads and suppressing brigandry across our realm. Founded by the joint authority of Fernando and Isabel, it replaces the old municipal brotherhoods with a centralized force answerable to the Crown. The Hermandad ensures that the safety of travel and commerce extends into the countryside, bringing the reach of royal justice far beyond the city walls.
mods: Allows us to raise Hermandad Infantry
Unlocks the Summon the Santa Hermandad cabinet action

CAS.name: Ayuntamientos
CAS.desc: The right to establish town councils with clear legislative and executive jurisdictions is a clear and fundamental right of the Commoners within our domain.

CAS.name: Caballeros Villanos
CAS.desc: Under their own fueros, the towns of Castile and León muster their own hueste concejil whenever the town council calls it to arms, rather than answering to the crown or the great lords.

CAS.name: Fuero Viejo de Castilla
CAS.desc: We have compiled the scattered laws and customs of our Nobility. This codification of their privileges shall serve as the cornerstone of their elevated status in our realm.

CAS.name: Mercedes Enriqueñas
CAS.desc: Through a permanent confirmation of vast concessions of lands and titles, we shall ensure the loyalty of those who placed us on the throne.

CAS.name: Regimiento
CAS.desc: The Regimiento is a system implemented to govern the town and cities of Castile through certain appointed councilmen, who come from the ranks of the richest and most powerful families.

CAS.name: Castilian Fiscal System
CAS.desc: The Crown's framework for extracting revenue from its subjects shapes the balance between royal coffers and the prosperity of merchants and estate holders.

CAS.name: Mesta Council
CAS.desc: The Mesta Association together with its council protects the rights and interests of the livestock owners in our country.

CAS.name: Alcabala
CAS.desc: The royal sales tax on all commercial transactions fills the treasury at the cost of merchant resentment — a broad levy that touches every deal struck in the market and every cargo sold at the dock.
mods: Unlocks the Alcabala Tax government reform

CAS.name: Encabezamiento
CAS.desc: Towns and cities negotiate fixed annual sums in lieu of the full alcabala, granting merchants greater predictability and allowing local assemblies to manage their own fiscal affairs within the agreed ceiling.

CAS.name: Grand Armada
CAS.desc: A grand convoy shall accompany the treasure fleets that bring the wealth of our foreign possessions into our home ports.

CAS.name: Quadrillas Organization
CAS.desc: Based around the fixed principal Cities of the pastoral herds, this is the foundational organization of the Mesta. Their supervision ensures the security of our pastoral sheep herds of the Merino Breed.

CAS.name: Right of Possession
CAS.desc: The Right of Possession regulates rent prizes for pasture fields and serves as the legal groundwork for the Mesta sheep herds.

CAS.name: Caballería de Cuantía
CAS.desc: The Caballería de Cuantía are the property-qualified horsemen of Castile — men of sufficient wealth to maintain horse and arms, but below the rank of the high nobility. Riding in the light jinete style, these mid-rank cavalrymen fill the space between the great lords' retinues and the foot levies of the towns, providing the Castilian crown with a broad base of mounted manpower in exchange for exemption from the common tribute — a narrower privilege than an hidalgo's, but privilege enough to keep a horse.

CAS.name: A Land of Castles
CAS.desc: Castile takes its very name from the network of castillos (castles, fortresses, and watchtowers) that has crowned every defensible ridge along the Duero, the Tagus, and the Guadiana since the ninth-century repopulation of the Meseta. Strongholds like Burgos, Gormaz, Calatrava, and the dozens of keeps of the Castillos de la Frontera are raised, manned, and maintained by frontier councils (concejos) and the military orders of Santiago and Calatrava under royal charter. Centuries of building have given our Crown a chain of strongholds along every frontier.

CAS.name: Armada Real
CAS.desc: The Armada Real musters the galleons and galleys of Cantabria, Andalusia, and Naples into a single royal fleet that escorts the treasure convoys and contests the seas from the Channel to the Levant. Our dockyards at Santander and the arsenals of the south build and refit the great ships, while a corps of trained crews man them through every campaign. A standing royal navy carries the historical Crown's reach across the open ocean, beyond anything a breakaway successor could assemble.

CAS.name: Hermandades Concejiles
CAS.desc: The hermandades, sworn brotherhoods of the Castilian towns, band their militias together to police the roads, hunt down bandits, and keep the king's peace where the crown's own officers cannot reach. Armed with crossbow and pike and answerable to their own elected alcaldes, these leagues field a standing rural constabulary that overawes unruly nobles and footpads alike. Funded by its own members, the brotherhood keeps order in the realm without burdening the royal treasury.

CAS.name: Real Academia Española
CAS.desc: Founded by Juan Manuel Fernández Pacheco, Marquis of Villena, on the model of the Académie française, the Real Academia Española takes as its motto Limpia, fija y da esplendor (to clean, fix, and give splendor to the Castilian tongue). Its first great project, the six-volume Diccionario de Autoridades, sets the standards of orthography, grammar, and usage that will bind together every Castilian writer from Cádiz to Lima. This institution makes our language the most regulated and exportable of the great European vernaculars, an instrument of empire as much as of letters.

CAS.name: Royal Arsenals
CAS.desc: The royal arsenals and Reales Fábricas de Armas gather the realm's gunsmiths and founders into crown manufactories that arm the regiments to a single proofed standard. Cannon from the foundries, muskets from the workshops, and powder from the royal mills flow to the garrisons through a state-run ordnance system. This military-industrial backbone keeps the historical Crown's armies equipped at a scale and consistency that no successor state could improvise.

CAS.name: The New World
CAS.desc: Columbus's landfall and the Capitulations of Santa Fe have placed the lands and peoples beyond the Ocean Sea under the Crown of Castile. We will charter conquistadors and licensed colonists on the encomienda pattern, granting them rights over indigenous labor in exchange for evangelization and a fifth, the quinto real, of all metals struck from the new soil. Castile alone, of all European powers, holds a system of rule already prepared to absorb a hemisphere.

CAS.name: Consejo de Aragón
CAS.desc: The eastern territories of Iberia of the Crown of Aragon shall be governed by the Consejo de Aragón. The office is mainly tasked with maintaining our ties to the mediterranean trade and the needs of the local fueros.

CAS.name: Consejo de Castilla
CAS.desc: The Consejo de Castilla is responsible for the lands of the Crown of Castile, governing these vast territories and its people in our stead.

CAS.name: Consejo de Cruzada
CAS.desc: Established in accordance with the Catholic Church and the pope, the Consejo de Cruzada will guide our expansion and our efforts to bring the light of the Catholic faith into all corners of the world.
mods: War Score vs other Religion Efficiency

CAS.name: Consejo de Estado
CAS.desc: The Consejo de Estado is led by our ruler directly, and is assisting our ruler in foreign affairs without the meddling of outside influence. The Council is staffed with capable members of our nobility and clergy, educated in diplomacy and foreign relations, and will manage both our embassies abroad and advice us on the navigation of difficult international affairs.

CAS.name: Consejo de Hacienda
CAS.desc: Replacing the two previous offices of Accounts and Major Accounts, the Consejo de Hacienda shall eliminate the friction between the two offices and create a unified bureau to handle the finances of the state.

CAS.name: Consejo de la Suprema Inquisición
CAS.desc: The Consejo de la Suprema Inquisición, composed of several apostolic inquisitors and led by the inquisitor general, oversees the religious orthodoxy and court processes of our country. They will be serving as the highest court of appeal in both ecclesetical and worldy matters.

CAS.name: Consejo de las Indias
CAS.desc: All which lies beyond the sea will fall under the jurisdiction of the Consejo de las Indias. They will administrate all trade flowing from the colonies and into our main land and our subjects on foreign shores, ensuring a steady flow of wealth into our coffers. The livelyhoods and regulations of our newly acquired subjects and the distribution of land for colonial exploitation will also be governed by this Council.

CAS.name: Consejo de las Órdenes
CAS.desc: Tasked with the administration of their former lands, the Consejo de las Órdenes will play a vital role in granting lands for our military purposes, increasing our armies recruitment pool and ensuring capable officers are educated and recruited into our forces.

CAS.name: Conselho de Portugal
CAS.desc: With our acquisitions of more territory, we should establish a dedicated council for our possessions within Portugal. The office will mainly adminstrate our atlantic trade and naval matters.

CAS.name: Establish the Royal Council of Castile
CAS.desc: For too long has the Crown been shackled by the whims of petty Nobility and the inefficient patchwork of local jurisdictions. The Royal Council of Castile, proposed by and supported by reformers and royalists alike, offers a vision of a more centralized, professionally governed state. By empowering the council to oversee tax collection, judicial matters, and appointments, we could better direct the resources of the realm toward national interest, rather than the indulgence of local governors.

CAS.name: Flota de Nueva España
CAS.desc: Dispatch the New Spain convoy from our best home port to our Mesoamerican holdings, collecting silver and precious dyes. The fleet routes through the Mona Passage into the Caribbean before assembling at Havana for the Atlantic crossing.

CAS.name: Fuero Juzgo
CAS.desc: The Fuero Juzgo is based on the ancient Visigothic code, the Liber Iudiciorum. As such, it regulates many aspects of daily life, making it especially appropriate for newly colonized lands.

CAS.name: Fuero Real
CAS.desc: The Fuero Real is a code devised by King Alfonso X of Castile to extend royal power throughout the municipalities of Castile.

CAS.name: Galeones de Tierra Firme
CAS.desc: Dispatch a convoy of galleons from our best home port to our holdings in New Granada and the Isthmus, collecting silver, gems, and hides. The Tierra Firme fleet is the artery of the Spanish colonial empire, carrying the wealth of the Indies to the markets of Seville.

CAS.name: Pressure the Andalusi Court
CAS.desc: We bring our weight to bear on the through every channel available, from the parias agreement to the threat of cabalgada raids on the frontier. Each month our hold on the realm grows tighter and the influence dims a little further.

CAS.name: Summon the Santa Hermandad
CAS.desc: We activate the Santa Hermandad — the crown-sponsored brotherhood of rural constables and militiamen that Castile deployed to suppress banditry and enforce royal order across the realm. Their mobilization boosts manpower reserves and steels the morale of our armies.

CEP.name: Cephalonian Raids
CEP.desc: The rulers of Cephalonia and Zante have developed a long tradition of raiding any enemy vessel foolish enough to sail without adequate protection through the Ionian approaches. These island-based raids amass considerable wealth through plunder and ransom while simultaneously weakening our enemies' naval logistics in the western Aegean, thereby allowing the tiny county to punch far above its weight and preserve its independence.

CEP.name: Ionian Sea-Wall
CEP.desc: As the lords of Cephalonia, Zante, and Ithaca, we sit at the crossroads of the Adriatic and the Mediterranean, acting as the first line of defense for Italy. Our naval strategy focuses on 'Anti-Access' warfare, using heavy fortifications and fast scouting vessels to deny the enemy the ability to harbor in the Ionian Isles. We are the gatekeepers of the West, and no fleet enters the Adriatic without our silent consent.

CEP.name: The Arsenal of Argostoli
CEP.desc: We have transformed the natural deep-water bay of Argostoli into a premier naval refitting station. Unlike the massive Arsenals of Venice, ours specializes in the rapid repair of small tonnage vessels like brigantines and galiots used for Aegean raiding. This specialized arsenal keeps our fleet at sea longer than our rivals, ensuring local naval superiority.

CEP.name: The Chancery of the Three Tongues
CEP.desc: Our administration has evolved to issue all decrees in Latin, Greek, and Italian, reflecting the diverse merchant and noble classes of the Ionian Isles. This linguistic inclusivity attracts valuable migrants from the mainland and the Italian peninsula who seek a stable legal order open to many cultures. It effectively reduces the friction of governance in a sea of diverse identities.

CEP.name: The Currant Trade
CEP.desc: The unique climate of the Ionian Islands allows for the mass cultivation of the Zante currant, a luxury dried fruit that has become a staple of European diets. By dominating the production and export of this niche crop, we have created a specialized economic engine that generates vast wealth for a relatively small territory. The 'Currant Lords' of Cephalonia are among the wealthiest nobles in the Latin East.

CEP.name: The Ionian Merchant Experts
CEP.desc: We have granted extensive privileges to our local merchants, allowing them to form self-governing trade companies that manage the most lucrative exports and imports. This mercantile autonomy has fostered a wealthy urban class that bankrolls the County's modern administrative reforms.

CHA.name: Gỗ Trầm Hương
CHA.desc: The resinous heartwood of our native trees, known as agarwood or Trầm Hương, is treasured not only for its enchanting aroma but also for its spiritual and medicinal properties. Across the seas, nobles and monks alike covet it for incense, perfumes, and offerings. By protecting our forests and refining our harvesting methods, we can turn this rare natural gift into one of our most prized exports.

CHA.name: Mỹ Sơn Sanctuary
CHA.desc: Within the lush valleys of central Champa lies the sacred temple complex of Mỹ Sơn, where for generations our kings and priests have performed solemn rites to Śiva, protector of our realm. These towers are carved with devotion and adorned with sacred symbols, connecting us to our ancestors and the divine. As long as incense burns in their sanctuaries, the soul of Champa shall endure.

CHG.name: Ceaseless Border Wars
CHG.desc: Surrounded by people that would oppose us, we face a constant struggle to maintain our borders. Our ever-vigilant soldiers have plentiful opportunities to hone their skills in battle, giving birth to a combat-hardened warrior people ready to reclaim the legacy of the Great Khān.

CHG.name: Chagatai Riders
CHG.desc: The horses of Genghis Khān trampled and conquered territories stretching from Europe to China. As his heirs and successors, our cavalry will instill fear of the same thing happening into our enemies.

CHG.name: Karluk Literature
CHG.desc: The Karluk language of the eastern steppes is far more worthy to carry the thoughts and ideas of our great lineage than Persian or Arabic ever could be. We must promote the use of our ancestral language, and create a new literary tradition.

CHG.name: Legacy of Chagatai
CHG.desc: The legacy of Genghis Khān is ours through his son Chagatai. All shall tremble before us as we reclaim his glory!

CHG.name: Scheming Court
CHG.desc: The constant power struggles between the various princes, nobles, cities, and tribes in the Chagatai Khanate have produced a nation of highly adept schemers. If we can put aside our quarrels and channel this energy towards outsmarting our enemies, it would be a great boon to our people.

CHG.name: Sons of Chagatai Khān
CHG.desc: We can trace our line back to Chagatai Khān, the second son of Genghis Khān, who once ruled these lands and established a powerful Mongolian successor state. Although a long time has passed since then, we can still claim considerable legitimacy by appealing to the legacy of our fierce ancestor.

CHG.name: The Glory of Conquest
CHG.desc: Let it be known that boy cannot be a man unless he has ridden first with our invincible host, that he can take no wife until he has taken another man's wife, that he is not worthy of a hut until he has burnt down someone else's. Let service in our armies be the only route to manhood.

CHG.name: The Mountain Khanate
CHG.desc: We lie sheltered between Balkhash Lake and the Tiānshān Mountains. It is a harsh and unforgiving land, one which our people know how to use as a weapon against would-be invaders.

CHG.name: Tradition of Conquest
CHG.desc: Conquering people can be a tricky business; not everyone is ready to accept our enlightened government. Still, we have discovered that there are easier ways to bring people into our empire than building a mountain of skulls — something that our ancestors never learned.

CHG.name: Unrelenting Horde
CHG.desc: Our armies shall march like the great hordes of Genghis Khān. Our troops shall trample our enemies under our hooves like blades of grass of our native steppes. All shall fear the power of our armies!

CHI.name: Legacy of Kublai Khan
CHI.desc: Kublai Khan was the one who solidified our rule over China. He adopted the style of the Chinese and proclaimed himself Huángdì of the Middle Kingdom. As long as we follow in his footsteps, our authority over the Dragon Throne will be recognized.

CHI.name: Red Cannon
CHI.desc: Developed by a conjunction of imperial gunsmiths and known also as Hóngyípào, this piece of artillery is the epitome of perfection of Asian craftsmanship upon European designs. Based loosely on the Culverin models employed in the West, these cannons have received further improvements, increasing their firepower and reducing their weight.

CHI.name: Báihuàwén
CHI.desc: Our domain stretches well beyond the horizon. The emergence of a common written language among our subjects will surely bridge the gaps between us, elevate our culture, and reduce conflict based on misunderstanding and linguistic differences.

CHI.name: Confucian Influences
CHI.desc: If we are to manage our realm properly, our advisors shall find great wisdom about administration in Confucian teachings, which emphasize meritocratic selection of officials, attention to administrative detail, and other foundational advice for creating a healthy and prosperous government.
mods: Head of the Cabinet Promotion Cost Modifier

CHI.name: Extensive Canal Works
CHI.desc: The many rivers that cross our domain have tremendous economic potential. By constructing extensive canal networks, we can connect waterways to inland settlements, making transportation easier while also providing a reliable water supply to our people.

CHI.name: Grand Coordinators
CHI.desc: Maintaining control over our territories, policymaking, and military operations is vital for the continuation of our dynasty. Through the creation of Grand Coordinators, a body of high-ranking officials who can coordinate governance across our vast empire, we will succeed in cementing our position through effective stabilization of internal and external matters.

CHI.name: Grand Military Parades
CHI.desc: Our illustrious military history of our people is a great source of inspiration and pride for our people. By conducting elaborate parades to showcase our armies, we will decisively demonstrate our martial experience and unparalleled strength.

CHI.name: Great Tax Reform
CHI.desc: Our wealthy nation has ample coin and bounteous, fertile fields, but all this abundance requires comprehensive taxation. The Great Tax Reform enables more efficient revenue management, which should guarantee a healthier budget for our realm.

CHI.name: Green Standard Army
CHI.desc: The Green Standard Army, a military force mainly composed of ethnic Hàn soldiers, coexists with our Eight Banner armies. Originally formed by surrendered troops and recruited on a voluntary, long-term basis, they attract individuals from socially disadvantaged backgrounds. Used as a police force post-consolidation, they will play a crucial role in local military governance, while Bannermen will be reserved for emergencies and sustained resistance.

CHI.name: Imperial Bureaucracy
CHI.desc: Our realm rests upon a tradition of sophisticated administrative institutions, from the Central Secretariat that coordinates all civil governance to the Censorate that holds our officials to account. We shall make this legacy of imperial administration the foundation of our state.

CHI.name: Jūnjī Chù
CHI.desc: Also known as the Grand Council, the Jūnjī Chù is tasked with overseeing military affairs. As the most important privy council, it has come to overshadow the Grand Secretariat that held sway over previous dynasties. Despite its crucial role, this council will retain an informal nature within the inner court, with its members holding other official roles besides their councilorship.

CHI.name: Jǐngdézhèn Porcelain
CHI.desc: Our Porcelain industry is emblematic of the prosperity and tradition of artisanal excellence alive in our Empire. By perfecting the already-superior Porcelain production techniques of Jǐngdézhèn, we will spread our cultural influence far and wide.

CHI.name: Lǐ Jiǎ System
CHI.desc: Under the Lǐ Jiǎ system, we are able to exercise control over our borderlands through the allocation of settled armies. By granting land and agricultural rights to our stationed troops, our borders will be safer and our authority shall be affirmed.

CHI.name: Monuments of Greatness
CHI.desc: In our people's many millennia of existence on this planet, they have endured thousands of catastrophes through sheer tenacity. This innate steely strength has come to be recognized as a defining feature of our society. We showcase our resilience in the strength of our army and the divine beauty of our art.

CHI.name: Nine Garrisons of the Great Wall
CHI.desc: In order to defend against the vicious barbarian onslaught, we must do more than simply repair the Great Wall. The Nine Garrisons are militarized garrison towns along the Wall that will not only help to defend the most important passes, but also improve the overall logistical situation on our northern border.

CHI.name: Reform the Grand Secretariat
CHI.desc: Considered the de facto highest institution in our nation, the Grand Secretariat has served our rulers for centuries. Wielding immense influence over administrative affairs, this body of cabinet ministers must undergo a reform to further increase its effectiveness.
mods: Improves Grand Secretariat bureaucracy positive effect by 50%

CHI.name: Restore the Salt Monopoly
CHI.desc: The Salt monopoly was once our most important revenue source, but previous Emperors abolished it to encourage free trade. It is time to return the Salt trade to state control.

CHI.name: Silver Standard
CHI.desc: By turning most obligations towards the central government - from poll taxes to the labor obligations of the peasants or the tributes of local officials - into a single silver payment, the amount of which is based on the population and cultivated land in each prefecture, tax collection will become easier and our income will increase.

CHI.name: Successors of Genghis Khān
CHI.desc: From the days of total conquest to the vast expanses of Genghis Khān's great Empire, our people descend from generations of earthshakers. Our people are the ones destined to author history.

CHI.name: Sānxītáng
CHI.desc: The Hall of Three Rarities is our most splendid repository of rare, valuable objects and works of art. Through the generous patronage of our ruler, it has flowered into a venue for academic discussions, lectures, and even cultural events, promoting intellectual exchange and scholarly pursuits.

CHI.name: Ten Grand Campaigns
CHI.desc: The Ten Great Campaigns are aimed at expanding our influence both inside and outside our borders. To achieve that, we will draft a huge army to crush any resistance that we might find in our way. We shall choke the life out of any rebellion before it has the chance to raise its head, and our glory will be eternal.

CHI.name: The Censorate
CHI.desc: Parallel to other institutes within our administration, this branch of our government is in charge of preventing corruption. The censors are tasked with keeping palatial intrigues and malfeasance in check, often seen as the eyes and ears of the Emperor.
mods: Improves Imperial Censorate bureaucracy positive effect by 50%

CHI.name: The Red Cannon
CHI.desc: The red-haired barbarians from Europe may be uncivilized and ill-mannered, but they do know how to make artillery and firearms of good quality. Importing and duplicating their weapons will give our army a significant advantage against all invaders.

CHI.name: The Tea Trade
CHI.desc: A staple beverage of our society, Tea has come to dominate social gatherings, becoming the choice drink of many. This will undoubtedly lead to not only new varieties being cultivated, but a production boom as well.

CHI.name: Tributary System
CHI.desc: A system of subjugated local warlords and other rulers who send us regular gifts of allegiance in recognition of our overlordship. To refine and centralize this system would help us tighten our grip and squeeze more out of them.

CHI.name: Tǔ Bīng
CHI.desc: In our quest to shore up our border defenses, it has become apparent that we must create a system of recruitment centered around local soldiers and stalwarts. These fighters will be a valuable addition to our military capabilities, and shall be kept separate from the Wèi Suǒ system.

CHI.name: Tǔsī Titles
CHI.desc: Titles granted to warlords and local strongmen, these administrative positions are used to quell unrest and keep the rural populace under central control.

CHI.name: Woodblock Printing
CHI.desc: The production of elegant illustrations, artworks, and books using this printing method has captivated our people's attention, and our master printers constantly strive to perfect their techniques. Woodblock printing has become part of our culture and, with recent improvements to and expansion of our literary production, will further elevate our prestige.

CHI.name: Wèi Suǒ
CHI.desc: Many would-be conquerors eye our lands with covetous intent. If we are to defend our territory, we must set up a garrison system, aimed at rapidly responding to hostile invasions. Through the recruitment of local troops, our defensive prowess will be supplemented through supplies and more efficient logistics.

CHI.name: Yúlín Túcè
CHI.desc: Tax evasion is a timeless problem that even plagued our ancestors, but we may have found a solution: By compiling registers for districts and provinces, we will keep better track of the taxes owed to the central government by every plot. This taxation is largely determined based on the grain yield of every plot that undergoes survey.

CHI.name: Zhōngshū Shěng
CHI.desc: One of the most vital branches of the Three Departments and Six Ministries, the central secretariat is responsible for the drafting and codification of many Imperial reforms and decrees.
mods: Improves Central Secretariat bureaucracy positive effect by 50%

CHI.name: Zájù
CHI.desc: Typically consisting of four acts, this brilliant display of dance and music is a colorful expression of the artistic heights that our society has achieved.

CHI.name: Central Secretariat
CHI.desc: The Zhōngshū Shěng was the Yuán dynasty's supreme civil administrative body, directing all governance across the empire from the capital. A well-funded Secretariat legitimizes the dynasty's authority through decisive, coordinated rule — but when its operations are neglected, the resulting administrative chaos raises the cost of every political decision the crown must make.

CHI.name: Grand Secretariat
CHI.desc: The Nèigé was the inner advisory council that in practice governed the Míng empire, drafting edicts, mediating between the Emperor and the outer bureaucracy, and coordinating policy across the Six Boards. A properly resourced Grand Secretariat builds imperial prestige through decisive, unified governance — but an underfunded one loses the Emperor's ear, and the legitimacy it was created to sustain begins to erode.

CHI.name: Imperial Censorate
CHI.desc: The Yùshǐtái under the Yuán — later reformed as the Dūcháyuàn under the Míng — was the inspectorate charged with rooting out corruption among officials and ensuring the law was upheld from capital to province. When properly funded, its investigators recover tax income that would otherwise leak away through official misconduct — but left without resources, they lose the reach to act, and estates move swiftly to exploit the oversight vacuum.

CHI.name: Six Boards
CHI.desc: The Liùbù were the six ministries of the Míng dynasty — Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works — that collectively administered the entire apparatus of the state. Together they represent the most comprehensive bureaucratic structure in the world; well-funded, they deliver a marked increase in tax revenues, but neglected, the six boards become entrenched power bases for factional officials who serve their own interests before the throne's.

CLI.name: The Count's Ambition
CLI.desc: Through a masterclass in marital diplomacy and unwavering loyalty to the Holy Roman Emperors, we have risen from local lords to Princes of the Holy Roman Empire. By securing marriage ties to the thrones of our neighbors, we have positioned ourselves as the indispensable 'Shield of the South'. So meteoric a rise lets us demand respect from the greatest of European houses.

CLI.name: The Last Count's Legacy
CLI.desc: Following our deep involvement in the successions of our neighbors, we formalize our legal claims to oversee the southern frontier of the Empire as the primary protectors of the realm. Even as our rivals attempt to absorb our lands, the administrative structures and 'Imperial Immediate' status we have secured ensure that our territory remains a privileged hub of regional governance.

CLI.name: The Marble Palaces of Celje
CLI.desc: To reflect our status as Princes of the Empire, we have invited Italian architects to redesign our urban centers in the grand Baroque style. These sprawling palaces and public squares are not merely for show; they serve as centralized administrative hubs where the state's bureaucracy is professionalized. The sheer splendor of our capital serves to overawe foreign diplomats and domestic rivals alike, cementing our legitimate right to rule.

CLI.name: The Modernization of a Nation
CLI.desc: Our ancestral valleys have been transformed from a feudal pastoral land into the industrial heartbeat of our realm. We have seized this momentum by establishing massive industries, alongside modern steam-powered mills that process the raw timber and iron of the surrounding mountains. This rapid modernization has created a new class of skilled laborers and engineers, turning our capital into a center of technological innovation that propels the entire state into the industrial age.

CLI.name: The Sanneck Condottieri
CLI.desc: Before we were Princes of the Empire, the House of Cilli was defined by the sharp blades of the Sanneck knights. By leading elite mercenary companies for the Hungarian and Imperial crowns in the fields of Dalmatia and Italy, we have turned the 'contract of war' into a tool for dynastic elevation. This tradition of professional military service allows us to field superior sellswords at a fraction of the cost.

CLI.name: The Windic March Arsenal
CLI.desc: As the primary lords of the southern frontier, we have transformed our estates into a permanent military supply chain. By patronizing the ironworks of the Savinja Valley, we ensure our heavy cavalry and border guards are equipped with the finest plate and firearms forged in Inner Austria. This localized military industry reduces our reliance on foreign armaments and keeps our regiments battle-ready at all times.

CRO.name: Antemurale Christianitatis
CRO.desc: Our cultural identity has been forged in the fire of the 'Century of Martyrs'. We have embraced the role of the Antemurale Christianitatis (Shield of Christendom), transforming our military struggle into a sacred religious mission. This mythos instills a deep, unshakable sense of historical duty in the population, viewing the defense of our nation as the defense of civilization itself. This 'Heroic Spirit' ensures that the national fire remains alive even in our darkest hours.
mods: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle

CRO.name: Legacy of the Trpimirović
CRO.desc: We look back to the glorious age of our native kings, such as Tomislav and Zvonimir, to inspire a sense of independent destiny and national pride. By tracing our lineage and institutions back to these sovereign rulers, we bolster our diplomatic standing among the courts of Europe and assert our right to a crown that is older than many of our neighbors'. This historical prestige commands respect from the Holy See and serves as a powerful unifying mythos that rallies the disparate regions of the kingdom under a single, storied banner of Romanic-Slavic royalty.

CRO.name: The Banovac Silver Denar
CRO.desc: We have asserted the right of Monetaria, establishing a sovereign mint to produce the Banovac silver denar. By maintaining a higher silver content than neighboring currencies, our coin has become the primary medium of exchange in the northern Adriatic and the Drava basin. This fiscal independence allows us to fund its administration without relying on external subsidies, turning our court into a regional financial hub that attracts Ragusan and Venetian capital.

CRO.name: The Baroque Pietas
CRO.desc: Our culture has embraced a dramatic and intense Baroque Catholicism, characterized by massive religious processions and the construction of grand, ornate churches. This 'Visual Piety' serves as a powerful unifying force, bridging the gap between the urban nobility and the rural peasantry through shared ritual and spectacle. This intense religious identity acts as a cultural shield against both Protestant and Eastern influences, ensuring that the Croatian soul remains firmly anchored in the Catholic-Mediterranean world, even while defending the central European plains.

CRO.name: The Baška Tablet
CRO.desc: The cultural soul of Croatia is anchored in the 'Zvonimir tradition', where our history is carved in stone. We have promoted the memory of our independent kings through epic poetry and historical chronicles, instilling a 'Royal Consciousness' in every peasant and noble. Even under foreign kings, the Croatians see themselves as part of an ancient and sovereign nation, and that pride keeps our culture vibrant and proof against decay from outside.

CRO.name: The Croatian Press
CRO.desc: We have established one of the earliest and most daring printing houses in the Slavic world. By moving our technological heart to the 'impassable' valley of Kosinj, we ensure that the production of our sacred Glagolitic texts remains shielded from the maritime raids and border skirmishes that plague the littoral. This press is not merely a tool for literacy; it is a laboratory of cultural survival where we forge the first printed missals in our native tongue. By standardizing our ancient script through the modern press, we provide every parish in the Kingdom with a unified, incorruptible source of our laws and liturgy. This ensures that the Croatian identity remains intellectually fortified and spiritually independent, as it reaches the hands of every shepherd and noble, anchoring the soul of the nation in an unshakeable, home-grown tradition.

CRO.name: The Jesuit Academy
CRO.desc: Founded by the invited Jesuit Order, this academy has evolved from a local gymnasium into the intellectual heart of our nation. By establishing a rigorous curriculum of Aristotelian philosophy, mathematics, and rhetoric, the academy has created a home-grown elite of 'Enlightened Croats' who are as comfortable in the salons of Vienna as they are in the Sabor. This reform ensures that our administration is led by educated men capable of navigating the complex legal and scientific shifts of our century.

CRO.name: The Lessons from the Uskoks
CRO.desc: To counter the advance of our enemies, we have transformed our coastal fortresses into a sanctuary for the Uskoks, refugee warriors who wage a permanent war. These light infantry units use small, fast boats to conduct lightning raids against enemy supply lines, surviving in the rugged karst where regular armies cannot follow. This policy turns our coast into a lethal 'no-man's-land' for our enemies, providing us with a cheap and fiercely motivated frontier guard that requires no support from the central treasury and keeps them constantly on the defensive.

CRO.name: The National Garrison System
CRO.desc: To combat the sudden amphibious raids of enemy fleets or border transgressions, we will establish a sophisticated visual system using smoke and fire signals atop the highest Velebit crags. This 'Mountain Watch' will allow our forts to communicate across the jagged terrain in minutes, bypassing the slow mountain trails. By coordinating these signals with the inland garrisons, we will be able to mobilize our nation and reinforce our walls before any action happens. This high-altitude surveillance will turn the impassable peaks into a centralized command tower, ensuring that no enemy can approach without our immediate knowledge.

CRO.name: The Pacta Conventa
CRO.desc: This legal bedrock formalized the union between the Twelve Noble Tribes of Croatia and the Hungarian Crown. By preserving the right to elect the monarch and maintaining a separate coronation with the Zvonimir Crown, we ensure Croatia remains a distinct political entity in the case of falling in Union with other nations. This contractual sovereignty prevents total absorption into a foreign administration, allowing our nobility to manage internal justice and defense under their own ancient laws.

CRO.name: The Royal Council of Croatia
CRO.desc: We have established the Consilium Regium in our capital, creating a dedicated executive government for the Croatian Nation. This body will act as a proto-ministry, handling the economy, education, and internal security of the Triune Kingdom. This era of 'Government by Council' will foster a professional class of civil servants who view the state as a rational, modern machine rather than a collection of feudal privileges. The experience gained in these halls of power will provide the administrative expertise necessary for the Croatian people to navigate the transition from a medieval kingdom to a modern European nation-state.

CRO.name: Uniting the Coast and the Inner Lands
CRO.desc: To break the isolation of our coast, we will oversee the monumental construction of numerous roads, linking the inland to our ports. This engineered highway will be carved through the limestone heart of the Velebit mountains, featuring advanced stone bridges and serpentine curves to accommodate heavy wagons. The road will transform our littoral from a desolate frontier into a vital economic artery, allowing the timber and grain of the interior to reach international markets. By physically binding the mountain hinterland to the Adriatic, we will complete the territorial integration of the nation, fostering a new age of trans-Velebit commerce.

CRT.name: Academy of the Stratioti
CRT.desc: The fierce Cretan mountain dwellers have been integrated into a professional light cavalry corps, blending Western discipline with the hit-and-run tactics of the Balkan frontier. We have established permanent training grounds where the sons of the local nobility and the Latin settlers learn the art of the Saber and Carbine to protect the island's interior. These units are now exported as elite mercenaries to many states, providing a steady stream of military prestige and revenue.

CRT.name: The Council of the Two Peoples
CRT.desc: The constant threat of external invasion and internal revolt led the Latin Kings of Candia to abandon the strict segregation of the early conquest. We have established a 'Great Council' where the ancient Venetian-descended nobility sits alongside the Archontes (the Greek Orthodox landowning elite). This shared governance allows for a unified administrative front, where the military traditions of the West are funded by the deep roots of the local Greek bureaucracy, ensuring the island remains a stable and indigestible bastion for any would-be conqueror.

CRT.name: The Cretan Labyrinth of Fortifications
CRT.desc: As new threats loom larger, the engineers of the nation have transformed the entire island into a maritime bastion of the Trace Italienne style. By reinforcing the walls of Candia, Rethymno, and Chania with earthworks capable of absorbing heavy cannon fire, we ensure that every siege becomes a multi-decade ordeal for the invader. This infrastructure allows a small garrison to hold out indefinitely against a numerically superior foe while awaiting relief from the sea.

CRT.name: The Galley Assembly Line of Suda
CRT.desc: By standardizing the parts used in the construction of light galleys at Suda Bay, we have pioneered an early form of shipbuilding from interchangeable parts. This allows us to replace lost vessels at a fraction of the time and cost of other Mediterranean powers. A ship built in Candia is recognized for its speed and its ability to navigate the treacherous currents of the Cretan Sea.

CRT.name: The Malvasia Wine Export
CRT.desc: The sun-drenched slopes of Mount Ida produce the famed Malvasia grape, which has become the most coveted dessert wine in the royal courts of Northern Europe. By strictly regulating the quality and the Seal of Saint Mark on every barrel exported, we have created a high-value trade monopoly that funds our naval defense. This liquid gold ensures that even as a colony, Candia remains the most profitable jewel in the Venetian maritime empire.

CRT.name: The Trapete of Messara
CRT.desc: We have expanded the cultivation of sugarcane in the fertile Messara plain, building advanced water-powered mills (Trapete) for refining. Cretan sugar is now a luxury sought after by the courts of Europe, competing directly with the products of the Levant. The gold from these mills pays for the crown's naval supremacy.

CSU.name: Adaptable Incan Army
CSU.desc: Invaders from strange lands have set foot in our territory, and threaten our very existence. But our armies are adaptive; they adjust to new enemy tactics, learn to wield their very own weapons against them, and fight with an unbreakable resolve inspired by their foes.

CSU.name: Chasqui
CSU.desc: The chasquis are the messengers of our state. Chosen from the fittest and most durable runners of our country, these agile men carry Quipu strings, messages, gifts, and other kinds of information, and deliver them to the target recipient. The spread of ideas, as well as the bulk of our diplomacy, rests on their shoulders.

CSU.name: Drafted Hatun Runas
CSU.desc: The Hatun Runas are the peasant class of our empire. One in fifty men are chosen for military service on their twenty-fifth birthdays, and conscripted for the next seven years. This conscription system helps us maintain a substantial professional army with superior discipline than the troops of our adversaries.

CSU.name: Improved Tambo Way Stations
CSU.desc: Our road system is one of our empire's most valuable assets. To further benefit our military and administration, we will erect tambo way stations along all the main roads. These stations will be built within a day's march of each other, and will provide shelter and carry supplies for travelers.

CSU.name: Llama Michis
CSU.desc: Llamas have many functions in our society. They act as beasts of burden, as sacrifices, provide meat and wool, and even give us fertilizer for our crops with their dung. Controlling the breeding and use of llamas through government michis, or herders, we ensure that the llama population is strictly monitored. This will provide an opportunity for the llama population to increase

CSU.name: Military Mit'a
CSU.desc: The mit'a is a mandatory public service system fundamental to Incan society, and forms the backbone of the military service. Every ayllu must contribute capable men, adapted to combat in the highlands, to provide labor for state projects and military service.

CSU.name: Mitma Obligations
CSU.desc: In order to undertake great building projects in the past, our rulers had to fulfill ancient traditions by inviting every single petty chief in our empire to the capital, showering them with gifts, and holding lavish feasts. As our state grows, however, this is far from an ideal way to undertake these projects. Supplying labor and materials for construction should be the duty of each and every chief in our lands.

CSU.name: Quipu
CSU.desc: A system which uses knots on a string to store information, do accounting, and perform other informational tasks. Each knot represents a number from zero to nine. The knots can also be used to refer to logograms on the same string. The knots show which syllable in the logogram to use, and by combining more strings, sentences can be formed.

CSU.name: The Vertical Economy
CSU.desc: No other empire is as well adapted to the heights of the Andes as we are. By maintaining settlements and storehouses at every altitude, from the lowest valleys to the highest plateaus, we have mastered the method of moving men and goods across the most difficult terrain, where other states would falter. Our llama caravans, our roads carved into sheer cliffsides, and our highland communities turn the Andes from a barrier into our own highway.

CSU.name: Warachikuy
CSU.desc: The warachikuy is a holy ceremony where young men are tested in their skills, valor, and wits, as well as their physical abilities like racing, marksmanship, combat, and durability for extended lengths of sleep deprivation. Those who pass these tests with excellence are promoted to the rank of officers for our ever-growing army.

DAI.name: The Nghĩa Quân
DAI.desc: Throughout our history, the Nghĩa Quân — 'righteous militias' — have risen in defense of our land during times of great peril. Composed of farmers, scholars, and local patriots, they stood against foreign invaders and internal tyranny alike. Though irregular in nature, their valor and devotion to the country have made them a formidable force when mobilized.

DAI.name: Viet Autonomous Villages
DAI.desc: The Vietnamese countryside is built upon the enduring strength of the làng, autonomous villages that embody the principle: 'customs of the village outweigh the laws of the king.' In a land of rugged mountains and winding rivers, these communities govern themselves, raise local militias, collect taxes efficiently, and uphold royal authority at the grassroots.

DAN.name: Admiralty
DAN.desc: Others brag about their superior ship designs, or their foothardy sailors who fight until they reach a pointless death. We, however, know better. No fleet, regardless of its construction quality or the mettle of the men it carries, can achieve victory without a strong leader. We shall embrace this philosophy and thereby vastly improve our naval efficacy.

DAN.name: Danske Lov
DAN.desc: A unified legal code for our country will bring a new standardized legal framework for our government to work in and our subjects to appeal to.

DAN.name: Rentekammeret
DAN.desc: The Treasury, or Rentekammeret will administrate our finances and the Rentemester will answer to the Ruler directly. This allows us better control over our country's finances.

DAN.name: A Maritime Nation
DAN.desc: We cannot produce everything we need to maintain economic stability on our own. We must instead rely on a stable trade network to export our goods and import everything that we ourselves are not able to produce.

DAN.name: Agricultural Focus
DAN.desc: While the Danish terrain is relatively poor in terms of rare materials available to exploit, they make up for it with agricultural abundance. We shall focus on optimizing our farming and food production, safeguarding our people against future periods of famine.

DAN.name: College of the Admiralty
DAN.desc: With the establishment of a centralized college to train our naval commanders, we will be able to produce skilled leaders familiar with our coastal waters. This will improve our marine defense strategy, and ultimately better safeguard Danish sovereignty.

DAN.name: Danish Legislation
DAN.desc: The regional laws of Jutland, Zealand and Scania formed the basis of our legal code for centuries. For the benefit of our realm, we should compile and unify these laws into a single comprehensive legal system, which will be known as the Danske Lov.

DAN.name: Danish Sea Networks
DAN.desc: Every part of our country is surrounded by the waters of the Baltic and North Seas. This gives us the unique advantage of being able to utilize waterways for both transport and communication, considerably shortening the time it takes to travel between regions.

DAN.name: Danish State Navy
DAN.desc: Our country is surrounded by water, and therefore vulnerable to domination by any power with a large enough fleet. To ensure this will never happen, we must fund a navy capable of protecting our coastline and projecting our power over the north of Europe.

DAN.name: Reliance on Levies
DAN.desc: Our domain is protected by natural barriers, namely the Jutland Peninsula and the Danish archipelago. This defensive geography is extremely helpful when we are under attack, as it gives us time to raise levies before our enemies can reach our core territory.

DAN.name: Reliance on Mercenaries
DAN.desc: Denmark cannot rely on a vast population to supply their armies. Therefore, we need to ensure that mercenary companies are willing to serve our state, while guaranteeing their loyalty with solid contracts.

DAN.name: Religious Uniformity
DAN.desc: In the tumultuous religious landscape of Europe, we must set Denmark on the path to righteousness, and remain true to the doctrines of our church.

DAN.name: Rentekammeret
DAN.desc: By establishing a separate department for our Treasury, the Rentekammeret, we will have better control over our finances and be able to run the government more efficiently. With the documentation of all our financial records, we will be able to estimate our future expenditures more easily, stabilizing our finances.

DAN.name: Royal Life Guards
DAN.desc: The Royal Life Guards are an elite Danish regiment that also serve as the ruler's personal guard and perform ceremonial duties.

DAN.name: Scanian Regiment
DAN.desc: The Scanian Regiment is a military unit composed of drafted peasants, established to reduce reliance on mercenary forces and build a more organized standing army under direct royal authority.

DAN.name: The Copenhagen Dockyard
DAN.desc: Our country has a long and proud history of shipbuilding. Our experienced shipwrights need a modern and spacious dock in which to construct a navy worthy of calling itself Danish. The waters around Copenhagen are the perfect place to construct such a dockyard.

DAN.name: True Rulers of the North
DAN.desc: The rulers of Denmark have claimed overlordship over the Nordic regions for centuries. Embellishing the legacy of Kings like Canute 'the Great' will grant us the internal and external legitimacy needed to support our assertions.

DJE.name: Djerid Marabouts
DJE.desc: The local Sufi marabouts of the Djerid, combining Ibadi religious orthodoxy with practical wisdom in oasis water rights, palm grove inheritance, and caravan protection ritual, anchor the religious and judicial life of our oasis cities through their permanent lodges and seasonal pilgrimage festivals. Our crown endows the shrines of the great founding shayḵs and patronizes the teaching circles of their living successors. The blend of Ibadi and Sufi traditions lends our clergy a depth and moral authority across the southern oases, beyond that of purely imported orders.

DJE.name: Hafsid Autonomy
DJE.desc: Our oasis confederation negotiates a careful autonomy from the central Tunis court, recognizing Hafsid sovereignty in name, paying a modest annual date tribute, and accepting periodic inspection visits, while retaining full internal governance, water rights jurisprudence, and an independent religious establishment. Our diplomatic envoys negotiate as equals at the Tunis court, and our merchant houses maintain factor relationships in the coastal cities. Our oases avoid the costly direct integration that flatland frontier confederations suffer. This negotiated autonomy softens the hostility of the central court and lets our treasury keep revenues that directly administered oases must hand over.

DJE.name: Ibadi Refuge
DJE.desc: Our oases (Tozeur, Nefta, Douz, El Hamma, and the smaller settlements of the Chott) serve as one of the last refuges of the Ibāḍiyya tradition in the eastern Maghreb, sheltering Khārijī-Ibadi survivors from the doctrinal conflicts of the early Islamic centuries. Our clergy maintains the distinctive Ibadi fiqh alongside the surrounding Mālikī majority, preserving a tolerance and a religious autonomy unusual in the Sunni-dominated regions. Ibadi tolerance and an established clergy give our oases a steadfast religious life.

DJE.name: Ibadi Revival
DJE.desc: Our late period intellectuals revive the publishing of the great Ibadi-Wahbī classical works (the legal commentaries of ath-Thamīnī, the spiritual poetry of the Djerid mystics, and the chronicles of the southern Tunisian oases) alongside reformist Arabic newspapers connecting our community to the wider Ibadi world from Mzab to Oman and Zanzibar. Our bilingual periodicals circulate from Tozeur through Gabes to Tunis, and our scholars correspond on equal terms with the Cairo and Damascus reformist press. The Ibadi-heritage revival binds our scattered oasis tradition into a shared modern identity and wins our state a wider readership and a standing among the smaller Ibadi communities elsewhere.

DJE.name: Oasis Assembly Governance
DJE.desc: Each of our oasis cities is governed by its own majlis al-jamā'a (assembly of palm grove owning family heads, religious shayḵs, and merchant guild representatives), meeting at the central mosque courtyard to debate civic affairs, settle inheritance and water rights disputes, and elect the chief judge for each ceremonial year. The assembly governance has no inherited royal offices; authority flows through consensus and from the legitimacy of the religious and scholarly establishment. This consensus governance lets our oasis confederation rule itself well and stay steady, thanks to a solidarity of faith and community that no autocratic court can easily match.

DJE.name: Tozeur Madrasa
DJE.desc: Our central madrasa at Tozeur (funded by the assembled palm grove rentier families and staffed by Ibadi and Mālikī teachers in equal measure) trains the scribes, judges, and missionaries of our oases through a curriculum that mediates between the two madhāhib and the broader Saharan scholarly tradition. Our graduates serve as qādīs across the Djerid, our students travel to Tunis and Cairo for advanced training, and our reputation for cross-doctrinal scholarship attracts pilgrim students from beyond our territory. Concentrated learning gives our state a more literate clergy and a wider reach among the southern oases than purely rural Ibadi communities enjoy.

DLH.name: Afghan Nobility
DLH.desc: Much of the Dehlavi nobility is drawn from the ranks of the Afghan community, a people with a long history of conquest and rule in northern India. Though at times a political hindrance, their martial skills are beyond question.

DLH.name: Cosmopolitan Religions
DLH.desc: India is a massive subcontinent with several religions present. In order to ensure stability within our realm, we should expand the rights of the different faiths, and secure the loyalty of their worshippers.

DLH.name: Hindustani Identity
DLH.desc: Foreign ideas of nationalism and cultural identity have reached India. While the cultural diversity of India will remain high, it is clear that our geography, as well as the values of Islam, give us all a sense of unity in the form of a Hindustani identity.

DLH.name: Indian Throne
DLH.desc: For centuries, every great Indian empire has been ruled from Delhi. It is the seat of conquerors and our birthright. All must know that Delhi is once again home to the rightful ruler of all India!

DLH.name: Indo-Persian Culture
DLH.desc: Persian has been the dominant language of the court ever since the first inception of the Dehlavi Sultanate. As such, the influence of Persian has synthesized with local Indian cultures.

DLH.name: Innovative Textile Production
DLH.desc: The thriving textile industry in Delhi makes our nation a hotspot for related technological innovations. As early adopters of the cotton gin and worm gear roller, we know the importance of staying ahead of the curve in these matters. We must now ensure that the spinning wheel is adopted as widely as possible.

DLH.name: Origin of Hindustani
DLH.desc: The Hindustani language developed from Apabhramsa — a Middle Indo-Aryan language — and emerged as the contact language of Delhi. As Hindustani has influences from Persian, Arabic, and Turkic but also Old Hindi, diplomacy with the Muslim world and the Hindu world becomes an uncomplicated task.

DLH.name: Protect the Grand Trunk Road
DLH.desc: The Grand Trunk Road runs from Kābul in Afghanistan to the coast of Bengal. Many of the most important trading cities along its route are part of our empire, and so it falls to us to ensure that the road is well maintained and free of banditry.

DLH.name: Re-integrate Former Provinces
DLH.desc: The once vast Dehlavi Sultanate has lost most of its former possessions, but we have not forgotten the means of administering them. As we work towards restoring our past glory, we will remind local rulers of their duties to the Sultan.

DLH.name: Restore the Greatness of Delhi
DLH.desc: The Dehlavi Sultanate once encompassed nearly all of India. It must rise again!

DLH.name: Revert Ghiyath's Reforms
DLH.desc: The foolish economic decisions of Ghiyath al-Din have brought nothing but financial ruin to the state of Delhi. We must revert his madness and restore the usage of gold and silver for our coins.

DLH.name: Tughlaq Architectural Revival
DLH.desc: During the height of the dynasty and the most stable period of our state, great architects and artists of grand vision constructed mosques and tombs in the unique Tughlaq style. As the decades went on and our power was challenged by internal issues, the resources for maintaining this architecture faded. It is time to revive it, and re-establish Delhi as an empire of art and wonders.

DLH.name: Turkic Conqueror Roots
DLH.desc: Although we call India our home, the ancestors of our state were of Turkic origins. Their early successes as conquerors and rulers from the days of the Mamlūk dynasty, as well as the achievements of the following Khalji dynasty, inspire our military and diplomats alike to push the borders of Delhi into every corner of India.

ENG.name: Benevolence Tax
ENG.desc: The Benevolence Tax is a special tax that targets Nobility with ample savings or those living extravagantly, since they can more easily afford larger contributions. It correspondingly reduces the tax burden on the poorest members of society.

ENG.name: Court of the Star Chamber
ENG.desc: The Court of the Star Chamber handles cases considered too sensitive or complex for regular courts, ranging from perjury to conspiracy. While known for its efficiency, the court faces criticism for potential abuses of power, lack of due process, and being used as a political tool.

ENG.name: Grand Remonstrance
ENG.desc: The Grand Remonstrance is a series of revisions to the separation of powers. It further restricts the power of the monarchy and prohibits clerical cabinet appointments in exchange for increased parliamentary support and a streamlined bureaucracy.

ENG.name: Magna Carta
ENG.desc: The 'Great Charter' is a legal document that aims to protect the feudal rights of our barons against unjust taxation and legal maneuvers by the Crown. It is also one of the earliest documents to enshrine the idea of civil liberties, such as the right to a fair trial and protection from illegal imprisonment.

ENG.name: Navy Board
ENG.desc: The Navy Board is an administrative body responsible for overseeing naval affairs. This centralized institution streamlines fleet management, resulting in more efficient operations and resource allocation.

ENG.name: Overhauled Admiralty
ENG.desc: The Overhauled Admiralty is an attempt to modernize the governing body of the Royal Navy. The reform helps strengthen our naval power while also laying the foundation for the navy's future successes as a formidable maritime entity.

ENG.name: Representative Parliament
ENG.desc: The introduction of the Representative Parliament marks a significant shift in political dynamics, granting the opportunity for individuals from humble backgrounds, such as Peasants, to secure a seat in Parliament. This privilege has traditionally been the exclusive domain of the elite and privileged classes.

ENG.name: Ruling Commission
ENG.desc: A commission of Nobility has effectively taken over the management of the kingdom, acting as regents. The monarch's ability to exercise power is limited, and their right to rule diminishes over time. The commission can only rule for as long as it retains the support of the parliament, or until such a time that the ruler amasses enough support to overthrow it.

ENG.name: Exempt from Poll Tax
ENG.desc: Following Wat Tyler's uprising, the punitive poll tax is abolished and insurances are given that it will not be reintroduced.

ENG.name: Ordinance of Laborers
ENG.desc: To the great dismay of the lowborn, this ordinance has been passed to prevent the spiraling salary costs of the Commoners, effectively fixing wages to pre-plague levels. Employers are also prevented from hiring excess workers, and it is mandatory that all those under the age of sixty must work.

ENG.name: Order of the Garter
ENG.desc:
The Order of the Garter is a prestigious symbol of our realm's highest ideals, transcending time and uniting worthy people of diverse backgrounds and talents.

Whether composed of the monarch's favorites, esteemed foreign dignitaries, devout members of the clergy, gifted artisans, or valiant warriors, this venerable order is the pinnacle of nobility and virtue.

ENG.name: Alms Knights
ENG.desc: In an act of compassion and benevolence, the Order extends its charity to men-at-arms who return home from service impoverished, and knights who are left disinherited and landless by war.

ENG.name: Holy Brotherhood
ENG.desc: With divine guidance and unwavering faith, the Holy Brotherhood of the Order of the Garter is composed of esteemed bishops and other senior clerics. By elevating these devout servants of faith, the Crown will strengthen the spiritual foundation of the realm.

ENG.name: Knights Companion
ENG.desc: As the noblest and bravest denizens of the realm, the Knights Companion are the very embodiment of courage, loyalty, and camaraderie. By elevating the most loyal members of the peerage, the Crown ensures that this prestigious order remains a bastion of chivalry, each member valiantly serving both the monarch and the nation.

ENG.name: Patron of Arts
ENG.desc: Recognizing the power of culture and the arts to inspire and elevate the human spirit, the Crown uses the Order of the Garter as a means to foster creativity and promote the talents of the realm's most gifted citizens.

ENG.name: Stranger Knights
ENG.desc: Through the inclusion of distinguished foreign rulers, diplomats, and knights, the Stranger Knights bring a wealth of diverse perspectives, and help the Crown extend its reach over our lands.

ENG.name: Wooden Wall
