HAB.desc: The victory of Rudolf I over his rivals secured our place among the great houses of the Holy Roman Empire and is the subject of many tales and songs. The fervor displayed by him and his knights in the Battle on the Marchfeld will inspire our troops for centuries to come.

HAB.name: Military Frontier
HAB.desc: Defending our frontiers is a serious issue, and puts significant financial pressure on the state. The solution we have hit upon is to make generous grants of frontier lands in order to build up a professional military class. This will ensure more discipline overall and facilitate migration to the underpopulated regions of our realm.

HAB.name: Multicultural Empire
HAB.desc: Austria is a diverse and multicultural realm, committed to embracing and accommodating its numerous ethnic minorities to maintain unity and stability amidst growing nationalist tensions.

HAB.name: State Industrialization
HAB.desc: Industrial modernization must always be a priority for our administration. Only through modern manufacturing can we compete with our rivals on a global stage.

HAB.name: Wiener Klassik
HAB.desc: Viennese Classicism is a transformative force in music. Our best composers' works shall revolutionize Western musical tradition through bold, trend-setting innovation of symphonic, operatic, and chamber arrangements.

HAI.name: A Frontier March
HAI.desc: As a border province of the Holy Roman Empire, Hainaut has developed a rough-and-ready spirit, born from centuries of frontier conflict. This spirit makes our people naturally inclined towards taking defensive action, which we can exploit to our benefit.

HAI.name: Bustling Towns
HAI.desc: Our lively urban settlements are full of potential. With just a little effort, we can make them and their hinterlands incredibly wealthy, allowing us to thoroughly tax them.

HAI.name: Expert Ambassadors
HAI.desc: Our rulers have always been skillful with their words, and their diplomatic acumen has established their influence far beyond our national borders. As time goes on and geopolitical pressures intensify, we must start cultivating friendship with other nations for protection while expanding our sphere of influence.

HAM.name: Wendischer Münzverein
HAM.desc: A newly founded organization between cities with a strong Hanseatic presence, the Wendish Coinage Treaty will provide us with a strong basis to facilitate trade and commerce in our lands.

HAM.name: Port Networks
HAM.desc: Our country survives through its strong ties to maritime trade and the constant exchange of goods. To maintain an orderly harbor, we will need to dredge fresh waterways and build more docks and warehouses, attracting new merchants and their ships.

HAM.name: Wendischer Münzverein
HAM.desc: A newly founded organization between cities with a strong Hanseatic presence, the Wendish Coinage Treaty will provide us with a strong basis to facilitate trade and commerce in our lands.

HES.name: Professional Army Core
HES.desc: Our strategic position within the Empire makes us an attractive staging ground for other princes' armies whenever outside threats arise. However, hosting foreign troops hurts our finances. To prevent this costly burden, we must raise our own troops and put them into service of the Empire.

HOL.name: Dutch Shipbuilding Industry
HOL.desc: With the invention of the fluyte, the Dutch shipbuilding industry has exploded. Domestic and foreign orders are streaming in, and business is booming! Never before have so many Dutch ships sailed the seas, and never before have so many of our people been employed in building them.

HOL.name: Mauricians
HOL.desc: The Mauricians are a very mobile infantry unit that shots its volleys by lines of shooters, so that while a line recharges their arms, the next is firing at the enemy. This rotation gives them a tremendous power over their enemies.

HOL.name: A Fortified Border
HOL.desc: Our borders are not well-defended by natural features, as is the case in some other nations. However, we have wit and wisdom in abundance, enough to construct the mightiest fortifications possible to deter our enemies and protect our families.

HOL.name: A Trading Hub
HOL.desc: Our nation is blessed with a well-established hub of cities focused on trade, and adventurous sailors willing to bring riches from all over the world back home. These seafarers will be an excellent way for us to trade with other nations and make significant profits.

HOL.name: Concentration of Power
HOL.desc: For too long, our nation has been unevenly governed by multiple Stadtholders across different provinces, with the most powerful acting as Primus inter Pares among their peers. It is time to make the position hereditary and concentrate authority in a single ruler.

HOL.name: Dutch Art
HOL.desc: the Netherlands has historically been at the forefront of technological and cultural advancements. We must continue to patronize inventors, artists, and writers to maintain our edge over other nations.

HOL.name: Dutch Education
HOL.desc: While our people always enjoyed superior literacy rates at all levels of society, this advantage is becoming more apparent in the world taking shape before us. Only those with a limited understanding would not take advantage of and increase this edge.

HOL.name: Hollander Sailors
HOL.desc: A land of sands and flooded terrain, the people of Holland have always looked at the sea as their natural second home, where bountiful resources and glorious adventures await those brave enough to pursue them.

HOL.name: Maritime Warfare
HOL.desc: As a maritime nation, our sailors are accustomed to naval combat, whether against members of rival nations or pirates attempting to plunder our trading vessels. In any case, our navy must be prepared to face any enemy at any time.

HOL.name: Platoon Fire
HOL.desc: Standard volley fire involved each rank delivering its volley in one go to maximize firepower. But we have developed a different system of firing by platoon, with the idea being that one part of the regiment would always be firing at the enemy while others reloaded and got ready for the next volley. This removed time between attacks that the enemy could use to recover or otherwise gain an advantage.

HOL.name: Trading Spirit
HOL.desc: Our country is surrounded by the sea, so it is only natural that we would brave the roiling waves in search of trading ports and enriching goods to bring back.

HUN.name: Powerful Magnates
HUN.desc: The powerful magnates of Hungary reduced the power of the Crown at every opportunity.

HUN.name: Golden Bull of 1222
HUN.desc: A foundational document that enshrines the rights and privileges of the Nobility. By virtue of this treaty, they are granted exemption from direct taxation, ensuring that they suffer no financial burdens from the state's demands. Moreover, this privilege limits their obligations to provide troops, safeguarding their liberties while enhancing their influence in the kingdom.

HUN.name: Hungarian Black Army
HUN.desc: Serving as a standing mercenary army for the Kingdom of Hungary, Hungarian Black Army is a full-time war-focused army, in contrast to other mercenary armies across Europe. They use an unusually high ratio of fire weapons for the period.

HUN.name: A Renaissance Prince
HUN.desc: The peasants consider their ruler a just one because they are officially protected from having excessive demands and other abuses heaped upon them by magnates. The ruler of Hungary is a true Renaissance prince: a successful military leader and administrator, an outstanding linguist, and an enlightened patron of the arts.

HUN.name: Bulwark of Christianity
HUN.desc: With Turkish power rising in the south, it falls to the people of Hungary to defend faithful kingdoms from the Turkish threat. Let it be known that we will not flinch from our sacred duty!

HUN.name: Castle Warriors
HUN.desc: The Castle Warriors, one of the most select classes in our society, are duty-bound to provide military service to their local ispáns in royal castle districts. Stalwarts from the earliest days of our nation, these privileged landholders hold a unique position, actively defending their realm while cherishing their hereditary rights.

HUN.name: Curtail Peasant Liberties
HUN.desc: Hungary is not blessed with protective natural frontiers. The wild plains that first brought our ancestors here were perfect for launching raids into the West, not for defense. If Hungary is to defend itself, we will need resources. The best solution is to allow our magnates to bind the peasants more closely to the land, ensuring greater productivity.

HUN.name: Found the Black Army
HUN.desc: Inspired by the writings of Julius Caesar, Hungary shall maintain a corps of professional soldiers. These warriors will be so fierce that our enemies shall whisper terrified tales of 'The Black Army' to their children at night!

HUN.name: Hungarian Unity
HUN.desc: Although our subjects have faced many external threats over the years, the spirit and will of the Hungarian people remains unbroken. Unifying Hungarian hearts is greatly inspiring to our patriotic soldiers, who will defend our homelands to the last man.

HUN.name: Order of Saint George
HUN.desc: This order, known as the 'Chivalric Society of Saint George,' embodies a commitment to the ideals of chivalry and honor, promoting these values through knightly tournaments and festivals.

HUN.name: Royal Free City Rights
HUN.desc: By declaring our urban centers as Royal and Free Cities we can prevent our Nobility from accumulating power within their bounds.

HYM.name: Guards of the Shannon
HYM.desc: The fortress of Athlone, standing astride the mighty river Shannon, is the key to controlling the heart of Ireland. The O'Kellys of Hy Many, long-standing lords of these lands, have fought fiercely to defend their holdings against Norman incursions.

JAP.name: Rangaku
JAP.desc: We have encouraged the study of Western matters. While some fear it is detrimental to our societal cohesion, others argue that lessons to be learned from the West are so valuable that we could not afford to do otherwise.

JUL.name: Order of Saint Hubert
JUL.desc: The Hubertusorden will serve as a glorious reminder of our knights' combat prowess! Joining the order will be a reward for our loyal knights, and its members will display our glory for all to see.

JUL.name: Order of Saint Hubert
JUL.desc: The Hubertusorden will serve as a glorious reminder of our knights' combat prowess! Joining the order will be a reward for our loyal knights, and its members will display our glory for all to see.

KAR.name: Home of the Whirling Dervishes
KAR.desc: Konya, our spiritual center, is home to the followers of Mevlânâ Jalāl ad-Dīn Muḥammad Rūmī. Their sacred practice — the sema — symbolizes the soul's journey toward divine truth. Their presence deepens the mystic traditions of our realm and reinforces our Sufi roots.

KAR.name: Karamanids Cavalry
KAR.desc: Cavalry has always been the cornerstone of Turkmen warfare. Our riders, trained from a young age and mounted on hardy Anatolian horses, uphold the proud traditions of steppe warfare with discipline and striking force.

KAR.name: Meḥmed Bey's Firman
KAR.desc: Meḥmed I issued a decree demanding that only Turkish be spoken in courts, dervish lodges, assemblies, and public squares. This act rejected Persian and Arabic dominance in elite circles and laid the groundwork for a uniquely Turkmen cultural policy.

KAR.name: Sons of the Salur Tribe
KAR.desc: The Karamanids trace their ancestry to the Salur, one of the major Oghuz tribes. Known for both their leadership and valor, the Salur legacy shapes our state's identity and our claim to represent the Turkmen of Anatolia.

KBO.name: Banu Hummay Amendments
KBO.desc: This complex system of succession laws and administrative procedures establishes religious obligations and requires demonstrations of piety from the ruling dynasty.

KBO.name: Council of Clan Heads
KBO.desc: By seeking advice from the leaders of our most important clans, we can achieve a more stable government, and hopefully bring more prosperity to our society.

KBO.name: Amenokal Salt Traders
KBO.desc: Seasoned veterans of Saharan trade, these individuals oversee and drive the caravans of Salt that traverse the inhospitable deserts.

KBO.name: Cima Fiefs
KBO.desc: As a reward for their victories on the battlefield, we grant frontier territories to our military commanders. This helps to solidify their loyalty to us, and improves the influence our capital has over our distant borderlands.

KBO.name: Control of Lake Chad
KBO.desc: Across the shores of Lake Chad, our Burghers interact and exchange goods with a multitude of folk from faraway lands. This volume of commerce, fully under our control, is the lifeblood of our economy and the foundation of our national stability.

KBO.name: Kaigama
KBO.desc: The Kaigama is the governor of our Southern territories and the chief of the army. With power, vigor, and tremendous influence, Nobility who hold this title have at times even played the role of king-makers, as they may decide who shall rule.

KBO.name: Serfdom Economy
KBO.desc: Our empire was built on the backs of our conquered enemies. The flow of forced labor within our nation is a cornerstone of our economy, with frequent raids and conquests further fueling our wealth and power.

KBO.name: Yerima
KBO.desc: The Yerima is the governor of our Northern territories and in charge of levying able-bodied fighters to form the lower castes of our armed forces. While not enjoying as much influence as the Kaigama, we may yet come to rely on what sway the Yerima does have when recruiting soldiers, since we continue to struggle against exterior and interior foes alike.

KBO.name: Iron-Helmet Musketeers
KBO.desc: Skilled soldiers who wear iron helmets for protection and wield muskets as their primary firearms, these troops have come to dominate the battlefields. They serve as infantry troops in various armies across Africa, under the banner of some of the most powerful rulers. Loading their muskets with black powder and lead balls, aiming and firing at their enemies from a distance, their thunderous volleys have stopped many charges in their tracks, whilst their iron helmets provide vital head protection during battles and skirmishes. These musketeers play a crucial role in the evolution of warfare, introducing firearms as a significant force on the battlefield.

KBO.name: Council of Clan Heads
KBO.desc: Delegating administrative duties to local clan heads may mean relinquishing some of our central authority, but our advisors insist that we shall reap great benefits in return.

KBO.name: Fixed Military Camps
KBO.desc: By establishing permanent military camps at strategic locations throughout our domain, we will ensure our army suffers fewer casualties from attrition and can be mobilized quickly when needed.

KBO.name: Iron-Helmet Musketeers
KBO.desc: As warfare tactics advance, so must our strategy. By adapting foreign innovations and techniques like formations, lines of fire, and new gunpowder recipes, we will surely be victorious!

KBO.name: Kanem Siege Tactics
KBO.desc: Our armies are experienced with siege machinery, but adopting mobile artillery that can maintain sustained fire would secure our victory whenever we attack an enemy's walls!

KBO.name: Ribāṭ Fortifications
KBO.desc: Used throughout the Muslim world, these small fortifications have provided protections to caravans, commercial hubs, and isolated communities alike.

KHM.name: Khmer Ballista Elephants
KHM.desc: The Khmer Ballista Elephants are a fearsome presence on the battlefield, utilizing a double-stringed crossbow mounted on top.

KHM.name: A Modern Navy for Khmer
KHM.desc: We cannot allow others to dominate the seas and control the trade our state depends on. Let us create a new, modern naval force capable of taking on any pirate or rival navy in South East Asia.

KHM.name: Ballista Elephants
KHM.desc: Elephants are impressive creatures and tower over any other animal we have seen. It is time to utilize these qualities to strike fear into our enemies by using these majestic animals in warfare. Elephants are also able to carry great weight, allowing us to mount war machines on them. Constructing double-stringed crossbows and equipping our elephants with them will create a tool that will allow us to dominate the battlefields better than ever before.

KHM.name: Expand the Barays
KHM.desc: While our existing water reservoirs meet our current agricultural demands, we could easily support more people if we were to dig new barays in other parts of our country, creating the foundations for new urban hubs.

KHM.name: Guided by Rivalry
KHM.desc: Our people were humiliated in the past by being forced to bow to foreign invaders. While not every defeat can be avoided, we use these old rivalries to spur our people to fight harder and longer on the battlefield, burning to erase the shame of these ancient humiliations.

KHM.name: Hydraulic Cities
KHM.desc: Our great cities are home to many barays and canals, primed to store and disperse water throughout the area. Constructing and maintaining this network of waterways with skill will ensure our population will thrive even during the unstable monsoon seasons.

KHM.name: Invite Foreign Experts
KHM.desc: While our own people are not familiar with silk-weaving and prefer other fabrics, we are lucky that foreign artisans have settled in our cities and established their own weaving workshops. We should adopt this approach for other industries by directly inviting foreign artisans to bring their skills here, and thereby universally expand our production.

KHM.name: Khmer Royal Processions
KHM.desc: Our rulers excel at creating dazzling processions, events of glorious splendor that very few others can rival. These extravagant demonstrations of our national wealth confirm the power and brilliance of the ruler and the astonishing riches of our nation. The glittering procession of elephants, treasure, and the royal guard will strike awe and respect in the hearts of our people, winning their unbroken loyalty and admiration.

KHM.name: Mercenary Leaders of Champa
KHM.desc: In the past, we both fought with and alongside the fierce warriors of Champa. If we can secure the service of their most capable leaders in times of conflict, we can ensure our own forces are trained and well-rested, ready to leap into battle as fresh reinforcements.

KHM.name: One Faith for Khmer
KHM.desc: Our country has lived through tumultuous times as royal patronage shifted between both Hinduism and various branches of Buddhism. We must promote the chosen faith throughout our country to breed stability, and trust that our ruler has chosen the true path for our people.

KHM.name: Recruit the Peasantry
KHM.desc: We will need to reinforce our army with new recruits, which are easily found among the peasant class. With some training, we will be able to ensure the ranks can be refilled at any time by capable soldiers.

KHM.name: Restoration of Angkor
KHM.desc: The great city of Angkor was once a brilliant example of our architectural genius. Due to external pressures, we had to abandon our construction efforts, but we should connect to the roots of our society and start constructing new monuments to our splendor again.

KHM.name: Secure the Borders
KHM.desc: Our lands are frequently threatened by invasion, and our precious Angkor lies especially vulnerable to siege. We must invest into a comprehensive system of fortifications, with sufficient garrisons to withstand any invading force, so that we can protect our people and national treasures from foreign conquest.

KHM.name: The Lifeblood of Khmer
KHM.desc: Our rivers provide an excellent way to transport goods harvested and produced in our inland territories to our harbors, which are connected to foreign trade routes. Utilizing this transport network will also connect our cities and make communication between them faster.

KNI.name: Autonomous Local Commanders
KNI.desc: The local commanders that man the posts of our Order have long demanded increased autonomy, in the name of efficient self-governance and allegiance to our cause.

KNI.name: Tongues Division
KNI.desc: The Tongue, or Langue System, categorizes members and assets based on ethnolinguistic divisions. Each Tongue is further subdivided into Priories, Grand Priories, Bailiwicks, and Commanderies. Each Langue has a designated headquarters, known as an auberge, located in the capital of the Order.

KNI.name: A Brand New World
KNI.desc: The world evolves, and those who fail to adapt are forgotten by history. Our Order has endured for over half a millennium, and we will not fade away now! Our mortal bodies will eventually join the Creator, but our Order must first become immortal. We will transform ourselves into the most modern nation of our age, strengthening ourselves from the very core.

KNI.name: A Never-Ending Crusade
KNI.desc: As long as any faithful Catholic is in danger of religious persecution, our mission is not over! Be it during a pilgrimage to the Tomb of our Lord and Savior, or while crossing the seas and fending off corsairs, we will never stop training and never rest, ready to leap into combat at a moment's notice.

KNI.name: An Order with a State
KNI.desc: While some nations are often described as an Army with a State, we, on the other hand, have always been an Order with a nation, ever since our acquisition of Rhodes from the Greeks. Nevertheless, we cannot help but admire how efficiently they have harnessed their resources to become a formidable nation. Inspired by their success, we will implement reforms to ensure our military can confront any adversary with confidence.

KNI.name: Assistance to the Suffering
KNI.desc: Our Order is named the Knights Hospitaller for a reason: we were originally the protective force of a pilgrims' hospital in Jerusalem. Though Jerusalem is lost to the Saracens, we still provide medical aid to those in need, including our brave knights, who heartily return to the battlefield much faster than most armies.

KNI.name: Crusader Tradition
KNI.desc: Knights of our Order were present in the wars against Saladin and defended the last Outremer Crusader outpost, Acre. If any among us needs inspiration to do heroic deeds, they need to look only at what the Knights of the Order of the Hospital of St. John have accomplished in the past. The name Knights Hospitaller is truly eternal, as is our famed courage in battle.

KNI.name: Defense of the Faith
KNI.desc: We have been driven from Acre and Cyprus, but the Order of the Hospital of St. John will retreat no further. In pagan times, a Colossus stood sentinel over the harbor of Rhodes, but today, the greatest fortifications the world has ever known have taken up the guard!
mods: War with No Casus Belli Cost

KNI.name: Ecumenical Defenders of Christendom
KNI.desc: The Reformation has harmed our cause as knights from Germany and Scandinavia have started murmuring questions about the nature of the Communion Host, but the always-present Turkic threat has a way of making such disputes seem minor. Perhaps we should focus on defending the realm, and debate theology once the Saracen threat is safely at bay?

KNI.name: Friends in Need
KNI.desc: Our Order was formed by faithful souls from every nation in Christendom. This fact, combined with our need for external support to fulfill our missions, have made us adept at recruiting helping hands for our cause. We will take advantage of our omnipresence in Europe to reach the ears of powerful rulers, and sway them to our side.

KNI.name: Inspired Builders
KNI.desc: While our Order's principal duty is to fight, we serve our people in other ways as well. Over the centuries, we have developed the art of rapid construction, erecting buildings and fortifications with remarkable speed. We will use this expertise to make our capital into both an impregnable fortress, and a dynamic center of culture.

KNI.name: Reconquista of the Sea
KNI.desc: In our frequent clashes with fierce foreign corsairs, the thought has occurred to us that these scurvy dogs might have the right idea about looting and pillaging the coast, but they are preying on the wrong targets. Piracy may be a vile sin in peacetime, but in times of war, it is known as 'privateering,' and that is another thing altogether.

KNI.name: Scourge of the Corsairs
KNI.desc: The famed Turkish privateer Hayreddin Barbarossa fought many legendary encounters against the Knights, but he was hardly the only corsair we have encountered. Turkish raiding and looting of all of Southern Europe, tolerated by the Barbary states and funded by the Turks, must end. The Knights will do their job protecting innocent sailors at any cost.

KNI.name: The Right Hand of the Pope
KNI.desc: As time goes on, and the Crusades start to fade from the memory of our people, the importance of having the Pope's ear increases. We ingratiate ourselves until we are the closest confidantes to the Supreme Pontiff. Naturally, our devotion to his service will benefit us enormously — and why not enjoy our hard-won privileges?

KOL.name: Cologne School of Painting
KOL.desc: Our city is home to many capable painters and craftsmen skilled in the art of bringing images to life through the media of wood, stone, and especially glass. With the support of a strongly established artists' guild, they will thrive under our sponsorship and illuminate our city to new glory.

KOL.name: Order of Saint Hubert
KOL.desc: The Hubertusorden will serve as a glorious reminder of our knights' combat prowess! Joining the order will be a reward for our loyal knights, and its members will display our glory for all to see.

KOL.name: Peace in the City
KOL.desc: Not so long ago, our city was nearly torn apart in the struggle between our burghers and our clergy. We must ensure that this conflict cannot repeat itself, and that every member of both our court and the city council cooperate in preserving Cologne as a central hub on the Rhine.

KOL.name: Order of Saint Hubert
KOL.desc: The Hubertusorden will serve as a glorious reminder of our knights' combat prowess! Joining the order will be a reward for our loyal knights, and its members will display our glory for all to see.

KOR.name: Noble Armies
KOR.desc: Permitting the Nobility to maintain personal armies is an excellent way to ensure they contribute when we form larger state armies, while also incurring more influence.

KOR.name: Geobukseon Turtle Ship
KOR.desc: The evolution of the Gwiseon Turtle Ship, the advanced Geobukseon Turtle Ship model has an increased bulwark height to increase its durability without hindering its mobility.

KOR.name: Gwiseon Turtle Ship
KOR.desc: The Gwiseon Turtle Ship is a Korean warship which utilizes oars and sails to outmaneuver other types of galleys, while also being equipped with light Chongtong - Korean firearms.

KOR.name: Hwacha
KOR.desc: The Hwacha deliver devastating firepower through their barrages of rocket-powered arrows or iron-headed bolts. Their maneuverability forces them to take a more defensive role in battles.

KOR.name: Panokseon
KOR.desc: The Panokseon is a multi-deck warship with greater size and firepower than the usual Geobukseon Turtle Ship. While still relying on oars, the sails of the Panokseon allow it to reach a greater speed comparable to galleys for its size.

KOR.name: Border Defense Council
KOR.desc: Our borders are constantly threatened, both by barbarians from the north and pirates from beyond the seas. To ensure our armies are always ready to meet every threat with swiftness, we will establish a council of officers dedicated to controlling and securing our borders.

KOR.name: Court Poetry
KOR.desc: Our aristocracy puts great emphasis on the cultural development of their spirit and mind. Literature, such as poetry in Classical Chinese, is seen as greatly valuable by the court. The nobility and ruling class alike are enthusiastic about the cultural impact of the written word.

KOR.name: Daedongbeop
KOR.desc: A new set of reforms that will gradually introduce previously ignored improvements into the tax system. The tribute tax levied against households will be replaced with a unified tax on arable land, and the tax on goods will be limited to a quota which lets enterprising peasants and wholesalers make and sell surplus goods. This will result in lower taxes for the peasantry, increased revenues for the state, and an overall rise in commerce.

KOR.name: Fortresses of Goguryeo
KOR.desc: Korea was home to many kingdoms in the past. However, the influence of one kingdom in particular is still felt today: Goguryeo, the precursor to Goryeo. Goguryeo has left us many legacies, including its stone fortifications and castle-building techniques, which are still in use to this day.

KOR.name: Geobukseon
KOR.desc: Defending our coastlines is vital to our survival, and as a result of this vigilance, we have developed the ingenious 'turtle ship'. These heavily armored behemoths will ensure that no enemy ship penetrates our coastal holdings.

KOR.name: Grand Code for State Administration
KOR.desc: To ensure proper, stable governance, we must first codify exactly how the government will work. This will be the basis for our nation's first written constitution.

KOR.name: Gunpowder Engines
KOR.desc: Our forces have been aware of gunpowder's tactical value for centuries. Through reverse-engineering Chinese designs and the innovations of Choe Museon, we have mastered both gunpowder production and the construction of machines that employ it for military use.

KOR.name: Gwiseon Turtle Ship
KOR.desc: The Gwiseon Turtle Ship is a Korean warship which utilizes oars and sails to outmaneuver other types of galleys, while also being equipped with light Chongtong - Korean firearms.

KOR.name: Hwacha
KOR.desc: The Hwacha deliver devastating firepower through their barrages of rocket-powered arrows or iron-headed bolts. Their maneuverability forces them to take a more defensive role in battles.

KOR.name: Hyangyak System
KOR.desc: Agriculture is the bedrock of our economy, and therefore efficient village management is paramount. To this end, we will implement the hyangyak system, which establishes self-governance for villages. These agreements establish behavioral standards, dispute resolution regulations, and other civil procedures aimed at creating stable, self-reliant communities.

KOR.name: Korean Artisanry
KOR.desc: Korea has always had artistic traditions, but art has truly blossomed since our national unification, thrusting us into a golden era of cultural achievement. Among our many accomplishments, the artisanry of our people shines as a beacon of skill and refinement.

KOR.name: Korean Barracks
KOR.desc: Our armies need a steady supply of troops to keep them in prime condition. Having local centers of recruitment and training will allow us to have easily available reserves.

KOR.name: Korean Gunnery
KOR.desc: As gunpowder technology advances, so does our ingenuity, and as a result we have devised a new defensive system. Although simple in concept and execution, installing cannons in our fortifications will increase their defensive capabilities tremendously.

KOR.name: Metal Movable Type
KOR.desc: Movable type is an ancient printing technology first used by the Chinese people many centuries ago. But it is the Goryeo dynasty who developed the metal form of movable type, streamlining the printing process. We can now print books with unparalleled efficiency.

KOR.name: Panokseon
KOR.desc: The Panokseon is a multi-deck warship with greater size and firepower than the usual Geobukseon Turtle Ship. While still relying on oars, the sails of the Panokseon allow it to reach a greater speed comparable to galleys for its size.

KOR.name: The Hangeul Alphabet
KOR.desc: The Korean language is so fundamentally different from any form of Chinese that the use of Chinese characters renders all except the most highly educated people illiterate. Our new alphabet is more scientific, and will allow all our people to be able to read and write in their own language.

KOR.name: The Hopae System
KOR.desc: The hopae is an identity tag system requiring all Korean people to carry proof of their name, birthplace, status, and residence. This allows authorities to quickly verify identities, and to track a person's movement, if needed.

KOR.name: The Korean Cannon
KOR.desc: Although we are already quite experienced at using gunpowder and cannon, we should not stop making technological advancements. By developing smaller, but more durable cannons, as well as inventing more efficient methods of reloading, we will revolutionize our artillery and greatly benefit both our army and our navy.

KTZ.name: Society with the Lion
KTZ.desc: Founded in the woes of the Western Schism, the Löwenbund is sworn to protect our lands from heretical revolts. We should grant them our official sponsorship and incorporate them into our court to further our cause.

KTZ.name: Society with the Lion
KTZ.desc: Founded in the woes of the Western Schism, the Löwenbund is sworn to protect our lands from heretical revolts. We should grant them our official sponsorship and incorporate them into our court to further our cause.

LBV.name: Upper Bavarian Land Rights
LBV.desc: The 'Upper Bavarian Land Rights' is a collection of old Bavarian legal codes which codifies many common practices within Bavaria. It also sets and defines the role of the Nobility in Bavaria's court and covers administrative matters of the state.

LBV.name: An Army for Bavaria
LBV.desc: Only with a formidable standing army will we have the military might necessary to match our ambitions. With careful focus, we can expand it without having a ruinous impact on our state's finances.

LBV.name: Bavaria Coin
LBV.desc: Our realm needs a new standardized coin to serve as our national unified currency. Establishing a state-owned mint in our capital would ensure our total control over this new coinage.

LBV.name: Bavarian Cultural Institutions
LBV.desc: With our homeland at the feet of the beautiful Alps, we are a destination for artists from all over Europe, who seek inspiration in our incredible landscape. If we were to construct and support the appropriate cultural institutions, we could refine our court into a center of refinement and elegance, one that could rival even the most prestigious powers of Europe.

LBV.name: Bavarian Dukedom
LBV.desc: We have been granted the rulership of Bavaria directly by the Emperor! By embellishing ourselves as the divinely-appointed protectors of Bavaria, we will ensure our legitimacy cannot be questioned.

LBV.name: Bavarian Hofkriegsrat
LBV.desc: Establishing a council with the sole duty of advising our ruler during times of conflict will help us develop a more capable fighting force.

LBV.name: Bavarian Imperial Knights
LBV.desc: Our nobles have distinguished themselves as formidable knights in the service of the Holy Roman Empire. We should nurture and scrupulously maintain these troops to ensure the survival of our ducal integrity.

LBV.name: Bavarian Purity Law
LBV.desc: The excellent quality of our beer has been celebrated for centuries, but for our brews to achieve legendary status, we must ensure their continued prestige and superiority for all time. Several rulers in the past have created regulations and standards for the brewing of this wonderful substance; and we could use this fact as a stamp of our breweries' quality.

LBV.name: Dreams of Unification
LBV.desc: We once were ruled by Bavaria, unified in culture and allied under a single banner. We must ensure that the new Bavarian state is equally mighty, a home worthy of its strong and proud people.

LBV.name: One Faith for Bavaria
LBV.desc: We must ensure our people remain united in their faith, and that they will not be divided by heretical thoughts.

LBV.name: Practical Diplomacy
LBV.desc: No matter if we are answering to an Imperial overlord or cozying up to a potential foreign ally, our diplomats must be prepared for everything. But only if they keep Bavarian interests first and foremost in their efforts will we be able to claim true success in our diplomatic maneuverings.

LBV.name: Skilled Brewers
LBV.desc: Our lands are rich in the crops and fresh water required to brew beer, and our people readily enjoy this abundance. Many small breweries could grow into successful businesses, with the right support.

LBV.name: Trading Hubs of Bavaria
LBV.desc: Our lands are frequently crossed by merchants wishing to trade Salt, Silver, and Livestock in the rich lands to our south. We would be foolish not to take advantage of their presence, and therefore will establish bustling trade hubs in our own lands to attract their business.

LIE.name: A Devoted Land
LIE.desc: As part of one of the biggest dioceses in the area, there is no doubt as to the depth of devotion our people hold. We will show the world that our faith in God is as strong as our faith in our nation.

LIE.name: An Inspiring Maecenas
LIE.desc: Our nation inspires artists from across Europe, who come here to create their masterworks. We will spare no expense to support these artists and attract new talent, establishing ourselves as a hub of arts and culture.

LIE.name: Athens of the North
LIE.desc: Liège has been a cultural center for centuries, the home of the most celebrated scholars in the region and the envy of our rivals. But we shall not allow ourselves to become complacent; we shall never stop improving our institutions.

LIT.name: Valakų Reform
LIT.desc: With the Valakų Reform, our Nobility are more regulated in their behavior towards our subjects. This supports the Commoners within our realm, while also solidifying their status as an independent estate.

LIT.name: Statutes of Lithuania
LIT.desc: A series of codified laws aimed at confirming the legal responsibilities and framework of the elites, as well as promoting a wave of centralization.

LIT.name: 'Supremus Dux Lithuaniae'
LIT.desc: If we are to defend ourselves against our aggressive Polish and East Slavic foes, we must project strength! Establishing the title of Supreme Duke of Lithuania will decisively assert our authority, especially against the growing power of our nobility and others who seek to violate our sovereignty.

LIT.name: Chancery Slavonic
LIT.desc: To help connect our people across our vast realm, we need a unified language, and require many literate members of the clergy to spread it. The development of such a language to record our history and maintain our administrative apparatus is not only a sign of national pride and prestige, but also a means of creating a distinct government, separating us linguistically and culturally from our neighbors to the east.

LIT.name: Columns of Gediminids
LIT.desc: The coat of arms that hangs on our banners originates from one of our most celebrated dynasties, the Gediminid family. Many of their brightest have led our nation through turbulent times into ample prosperity with careful statesmanship and capable guidance. The columns of such great leaders symbolize the strong foundation and tenacity of our country and our fellow men and women.

LIT.name: Holy See Ties
LIT.desc: Years of negotiations with the Holy Father have resulted in our embracing Catholicism, with the blessing of our Polish neighbors and the Pope himself, during a turbulent and unique Christianization process. After our struggle to seek our spiritual identity subsided, it is clear that we have become a beacon of Catholicism, a shield against the heathens and heretics that threaten our society.

LIT.name: Land of Many Religions
LIT.desc: Our people coexist with fellow men and women of many faiths. This diverse social composition is embedded in our legal frameworks and beliefs. Together, we are stronger!

LIT.name: Lithuanian Renaissance
LIT.desc: Lithuania experienced a Renaissance in the late 15th and early 16th centuries. Inspired by the ideas of the Reformation and influenced by the Italian Renaissance, there was a prolific flourishing of education, arts, architecture, and literature during this era. This period will also see the creation of a written form of Lithuanian and, subsequently, the first works of Lithuanian literature.

LIT.name: Migrant Opportunities
LIT.desc: Mercantile opportunities and the promise of a better life are some of the reasons as to why our towns and settlements tend to receive constant waves of immigration. Many men and women relocate to our lands seeking their fortune, and their presence and contributions increase our fortune in turn.

LIT.name: Patriarchate of Lithuania
LIT.desc: The abolition of Romuva, a faith embraced by our ancestors, has shaken the very foundations of Lithuanian society. Yet, in order to secure a brighter future, we have chosen the path of Orthodoxy and fully celebrate our new identity. But if we are to be successful in that, the religious authorities of our newfound Orthodox faith must maintain autonomy from foreign patriarchates in order to avoid external interference.

LIT.name: Statutes of Lithuania
LIT.desc: Statutes of Lithuania are a set of three different legal reforms which aggregate, unify, and update the laws of the realm. Known for harsh punishments and the introduction of the death penalty, these statutes are in line with many contemporary Western penal codes. Each crime is supposed to be punished the same regardless of the class of the person committing it, but in practice, the peasants were often at a disadvantage compared to how members of other estates were treated.

LIT.name: Two Realms
LIT.desc: Due to the size of our realm, our jurisdiction falls under two distinct frameworks: To the north lies the core of our territories, proudly embracing our cultural traditions and social mores. However, our southern and eastern regions often diverge to a certain degree from our central norms. To respect such diversity will strengthen our nation as well as our position on the geopolitical stage.

LIT.name: Warlord Dukes
LIT.desc: Over two remarkable centuries of warfare, Lithuanian warlord dukes transformed a loose federation of tribes into a unified warrior state. They mounted fierce resistance against the aggression of Catholic holy orders, while simultaneously conquering vast territories in the East. These legendary achievements continue to inspire our military leaders today.

LIV.name: Baltic Crusader Forts
LIV.desc: The many fortifications in our territories owe their construction and funding to our numerous Crusader bands. Flanked by sturdy walls, these fortifications will serve and protect our people for years to come!

LIV.name: Bannerets of the Livonian Order
LIV.desc: The knights of our order have proven their valor and skill in battle time and time again. By promoting the most capable among them to bannerets, we ensure that our armies will always be led by the best.

LIV.name: Knights of the Livonian Order
LIV.desc: Our nation is founded on the strong backs of the brave Christian men who have joined our order as knights. Their martial prowess will compensate for our low numbers, compared to those of the Pagans surrounding us, as will the light and strength of our faith.

LUB.name: Wendischer Münzverein
LUB.desc: A newly founded organization between cities with a strong Hanseatic presence, the Wendish Coinage Treaty will provide us with a strong basis to facilitate trade and commerce in our lands.

LUB.name: Port Networks
LUB.desc: Our country survives through its strong ties to maritime trade and the constant exchange of goods. To maintain an orderly harbor, we will need to dredge fresh waterways and build more docks and warehouses, attracting new merchants and their ships.

LUB.name: Wendischer Münzverein
LUB.desc: A newly founded organization between cities with a strong Hanseatic presence, the Wendish Coinage Treaty will provide us with a strong basis to facilitate trade and commerce in our lands.

LUC.name: Counter-Reform Diplomacy
LUC.desc: We have maintained our independence by navigating the religious upheavals of the age through careful and measured diplomacy. Our commitment to our faith has been sincere but never fanatical, allowing us to preserve the goodwill of both the devout and the pragmatic. This balance of piety and prudence has become the art by which our republic endures.

LUC.name: The City Walls
LUC.desc: We have encircled our city with a great ring of Renaissance bastions, one of the finest defensive works of the age, completed over decades of labor and civic investment. The walls are so wide at the base that walkways run along their tops, and they have never been breached by any enemy. This fortification has allowed us to remain free where neighboring cities have fallen.

LUC.name: The Lucchese Constitution
LUC.desc: Our ancient Republican Constitution has survived the ages through careful governance and the determination of our citizenry to resist tyranny. When neighboring cities fell to princes and conquerors, we maintained our written laws and our councils without interruption. Our enduring order has given our state a stability that larger and more powerful neighbors envy.

LUC.name: The Musical Tradition
LUC.desc: Our city has long nurtured the musical arts, drawing composers and performers to its churches, salons, and public celebrations. Our chapelmasters and instrument makers have achieved such renown that talented Musicians seek appointment here as a mark of distinction. This tradition turns our city into a stage and fills its streets with an art we have made unmistakably our own.

LUC.name: The Silk Republic
LUC.desc: We have long woven the finest Lucchese Silk Brocade in all of Italy, and our looms have made our city prosperous beyond its size. Our weavers' guilds protect the secrets of the craft and ensure the quality that commands high prices in distant markets. This mastery of cloth transforms raw threads into the foundation of our republic's wealth.

LUC.name: The Towers of Lucca
LUC.desc: The great towers built by our noble families rise above the rooflines of our city, each one a declaration of prestige and power within the republic. The Torre Guinigi stands tallest among them, crowned with the ilex trees that have become the emblem of our city. These towers remind all who enter that our strength rests in the ambition and rivalry of citizens who have learned to compete in stone.

LUX.name: Destined to Rule
LUX.desc: The great Luxembourg dynasty, whose very name is derived from that of our nation, is now the most important family in Europe. This has to be a sign from Heaven, and we will use this divine benediction to further extend our influence.

LUX.name: Heirs of John the Blind
LUX.desc: John the Blind, the heroic King of Bohemia and Count of Luxembourg, was born in our humble realm. He died in the Battle of Crécy at fifty, having charged headlong into combat despite his blindness. His brave, honorable death will inspire our soldiers for centuries.

LUX.name: The Fortress of Europe
LUX.desc: The impregnable position of Luxembourg, with the formation of the Bock acting as a natural fortress, is incredibly strong. Our enemies would perish in any attempt to usurp our holdings. We shall learn from nature, and construct all our fortresses so as to use the local terrain to their advantage.

MAI.name: Bengler Society
MAI.desc: The Klüppelgesellschaft has been founded by a group of knights concerned about the erosion of our power within the Holy Roman Empire. It would be wise of us to sponsor those willing to fight for our status.

MAI.name: Diadema Regni
MAI.desc: Our beloved city has been described as 'Diadema Regni', the Crown of the Empire, a moniker we strive mightily to maintain. Maintaining this distinction will help us remain above other Imperial cities in terms of our prestige and political influence.

MAI.name: Garrison of the Rhine
MAI.desc: Defending our borders can be a difficult task, especially considering the river splitting our land in two. We must build an extensive network of garrisons and fortifications that can withstand our enemies.

MAI.name: Governance of the Vicar
MAI.desc: To ensure our lands are governed reliably, even in the absence of our ruler, we should instate a vicar. Empowered with extensive rights, the vicar can rule with our best intentions and remind the common folk of our presence at all times.

MAI.name: Mainzer Königreich
MAI.desc: While celebrations on Ash Wednesday are a common occurrence, they hold especially deep roots in our country. While the public celebrates the Fastnacht, or carnival, with masquerade and excessive feasts, our court will engage in a special event. During the carnival celebrations, we will redistribute the roles of our court per lottery, with even the ruler having to participate. This custom of swapping roles, called Mainzer Königreich, will spread far beyond our borders and help expand our cultural legacy.

MAI.name: Printing Shops of Mainz
MAI.desc: By expanding our already-growing printing industry, we can become the leading producer of books in Europe.

MAI.name: Protect Our Faith
MAI.desc: Our country's religious unity must be defended against any threat. If we provide our armies with moral guidance in the form of military chaplains, they will be much more motivated to defend our beliefs.

MAI.name: Rheinish League
MAI.desc: When the Rheinish League was active, we naturally assumed a position of leadership and guidance for the other members. Although the League itself has disbanded, we must do everything we can to maintain our influence over our former associates.

MAI.name: Rights of the City
MAI.desc: The citizens of Mainz have prospered under the extensive rights granted to them by Adalbert of Mainz in the early 12th century. These rights, carved into the bronze door of the Cathedral, will serve as a reminder of cooperation between the separate powers within the city, both the clergy and the citizenry.
mods: Possible Burghers in Towns and Cities

MAI.name: Bengler Society
MAI.desc: The Klüppelgesellschaft has been founded by a group of knights concerned about the erosion of our power within the Holy Roman Empire. It would be wise of us to sponsor those willing to fight for our status.

MAJ.name: Office of the Mahapatih
MAJ.desc: Equivalent in status to a prime minister, the Mahapatih has tremendous influence in our political sphere. As the second in command over the entire nation, whoever holds this office is charged with overseeing critical affairs of the state, such as military expansion and the effective operation of the government.

MAJ.name: Cetbang
MAJ.desc: One of the most prominent muzzle-loaded cannons of our era is the Cetbang. Armed with a cylindrical short barrel, it delivers a devastating blow with tremendous power. Such is its popularity, that it finds use in many aspects of our conduct of warfare, from protecting our ports to being the main armament of our warships and armies.

MAJ.name: Jong
MAJ.desc: The Jong has proudly served our people for a long time. Its characteristic number of masts and hull are made of thick wood, making it the perfect vessel for a combination of ferrying goods across long distances, as well as troops.

MAJ.name: Kabang
MAJ.desc: Used widely across the entirety of the Indonesia, the Kabang is a versatile ship of medium size and often crafted from a single piece of wood. Beyond its role as transport of people and goods, it has come to be synonymous with sea nomads. These folk consist of populations of peasants and fishermen who used the tide and monsoons to migrate from port to port, making a living off the sea.

MAJ.name: Late Karambit Warriors
MAJ.desc: Armed with rudimentary armor and their trademark blade, these warriors rely on mastering speed, ferocity, and fluent movements. They excel on close combat where the karambit's curved blade is extremely efficient at slashing, hooking, and gutting opponents. The adoption and proliferation of new formations and combat maneuvers has turned these warriors into a fabled armed force, feared throughout the archipelago.

MAJ.name: Madurese Ghali
MAJ.desc: The people that populate the Madura Strait have come to serve in our navy. Their naval prowess and great shipbuilding skills have given rise to a new kind of vessel, the Madurese Ghali. A large ship, it is used for offensive and voyager-adjacent tasks, as it will soon comprise the backbone of our fleet.

MAJ.name: Bubu & Jala
MAJ.desc: Some of the most efficient fishing techniques are employed in local fish traps, known as Bubu. Woven soft wood, such as bamboo, they are tended to by experienced fishermen in strategic locations such as river mouths and employed intricate techniques to maximize their catch.

MAJ.name: Foreign Architectural Influence
MAJ.desc: In our many conquests across Indonesia, we have encountered many new and incredible forms of art, all of which could be adopted and refined by our people to further our legacy. By introducing new techniques and sponsoring artists, our culture will come to exemplify the artistic achievements of our region.

MAJ.name: Home of the Sea Nomads
MAJ.desc: Used widely across the entirety of the Indonesia, the Kabang is a versatile ship of medium size and often crafted from a single piece of wood. Beyond its role as transport of people and goods, it has come to be synonymous with sea nomads. These folk consist of populations of peasants and fishermen who used the tide and monsoons to migrate from port to port, making a living off the sea.

MAJ.name: Island Colonies
MAJ.desc: Contact with our neighbors in the archipelago has shown us clearly that the raw resources and unclaimed lands are ripe for the taking, promising to become secure and prosperous under our control.

MAJ.name: Jong
MAJ.desc: The Jong has proudly served our people for a long time. Its characteristic number of masts and hull are made of thick wood, making it the perfect vessel for a combination of ferrying goods across long distances, as well as troops.
